title: Senior Data Engineer
description: <p><em>This is a permanent full-time opportunity for those based in the UK.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><strong>About Nearform<br></strong>Nearform is an independent team of data &amp; AI experts, engineers, and designers who build intelligent digital solutions and capability at pace. We create AI-enabled solutions that enhance digital experiences, empower developers, and deliver measurable results. In these ways, we partner with ambitious enterprises to deliver enduring impact.</p> <p>Our deep expertise in solving the world’s most complex digital problems, along with our collaborative, people-first approach, enables enterprises to build breakthrough products and modernise legacy systems by unleashing the power of AI.</p> <p>Today, our team of 500 experts in 20+ countries is trusted by leading enterprises including Lululemon, Puma, Sun Life, Starbucks, Travelex, Virgin Media 02, and Walmart.&nbsp;&nbsp;</p> <p>As part of our Engineering function, you will work closely with clients to translate complex business requirements into innovative digital products.&nbsp;Whether you are a Senior Engineer, Tech Lead, or DevOps Engineer, you will collaborate with distributed teams, leveraging cutting-edge technologies to build secure, high-performance applications. Our Nearform engineers are known for building high quality, scalable solutions that solve real world problems.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>About the Senior Data Engineer role</strong></p> <p>As a Senior Data Engineer at Nearform your main task will be designing, building, and maintaining scalable data platforms, pipelines, and warehouses using SQL, Python, Spark, and other relevant technologies. You will play a key role in building efficient data solutions, optimizing performance, and ensuring seamless data integration. However as you’ll likely work on a variety of projects your responsibilities may also include:</p> <ul> <li>Designing, building, and optimizing data pipelines and ETL processes for large-scale data ingestion and transformation.</li> <li>Developing and maintaining data platforms and warehousing solutions to support analytics and business intelligence needs.</li> <li>Implementing scalable data storage solutions and ensuring high availability and performance.</li> <li>Enhancing performance in data processing workflows for maximum speed and scalability.</li> <li>Collaborating with data scientists, analysts, and stakeholders to understand business needs and translate them into data engineering solutions.</li> <li>Ensuring data quality, governance, and compliance across all systems.</li> <li>Supporting CI/CD processes for data pipeline deployments and implementing best practices in DevOps for data workflows.</li> <li>Conducting code reviews and enforcing best practices in version control, automation, and testing.</li> <li>Assisting with defining structured source code management and deployment processes.</li> <li>Working with and supporting Technical Leaders in project execution and timely delivery.</li> <li>Collaborating with client teams.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What we are looking for in this person</strong></p> <ul> <li>Significant experience delivering at a Senior Engineer level, specialising in Data engineering. Our Seniors typically have at least 6 years’ commercial experience.</li> <li>Practical experience of delivering in an agile environment.</li> <li>Practical experience and knowledge of developing real-world solutions.</li> <li>Extensive hands-on experience in SQL, Python, and Spark for large-scale data processing.</li> <li>Databricks experience&nbsp;</li> <li>Strong expertise in data warehousing technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, or similar).</li> <li>Experience with distributed data processing frameworks (Spark, Hadoop, or similar).</li> <li>Deep understanding of ETL processes, data modeling, and schema design.</li> <li>Strong experience with cloud-based data solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP) and data lake architectures.</li> <li>Experience with automation, CI/CD for data pipelines, and Infrastructure as Code (IaC).</li> <li>Deep understanding of versioning control tools - e.g. Git.</li> <li>Experience building software collaboratively using pull requests and code reviews.</li> <li>Familiarity with data governance, security, and compliance best practices.</li> <li>Excellent communication and collaboration skills.</li> <li>Professional proficiency in English.</li> <li>Must hold valid passport for travel.&nbsp;</li> <li>Travel, this role will require up to 1 week per month onsite in Germany.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Benefits &amp; Perks</strong></p> <ul> <li><strong>Annual Company Bonus -</strong>&nbsp;We all help Nearform to hit company goals so we all receive a share of the profits on an annual basis in line with company performance.&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Work Remotely and Flexibly -</strong> We have a genuine dedication to work/life balance. Our flexible working culture allows you to work around what matters - school run, no problem!&nbsp;</li> <li><strong>Paid Time Off Package -</strong> We offer an annual leave of 25 days plus public holidays. We also offer sick leave, marriage leave and many more.</li> <li><strong>Remote Working Allowance - </strong>Every 2 years, you will have a budget of up to €1250 (equivalent in GBP) to help you set up a comfortable and productive workspace in addition to your essential equipment provided by Nearform when you join.</li> <li><strong>Training and Development Allowance -</strong> We understand the importance of continuously learning so we offer an allowance of up to €1000 (equivalent in GBP) you can use to upskill yourself.</li> <li><strong>Healthcare -</strong> It’s important to always take care of your health, so we offer additional private healthcare here at Nearform. If you wish to learn more about the plan offered feel free to reach out to our team.</li> <li><strong>Pension &amp; Insurances</strong> <strong>-</strong> We offer a pension match of up to 5% and Income Protection and Death in Service for peace of mind.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Our Interview Process</strong></p> <p><strong>Talent Call</strong> (30 mins via Zoom)<br>An introductory conversation with a member of our Talent Team to learn more about your background, experience, and career goals. We'll also provide a high-level overview of Nearform and answer any questions you may have. This step helps us assess initial alignment.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Technical Assessment</strong> (1 hour via Zoom)<br>A live coding challenge with one of our trained interviewers. You'll be asked to build a working solution to a problem via screen sharing, demonstrating your data engineering expertise, problem-solving ability, and coding best practices in a real-time environment.</p> <hr> <p><strong>Hiring Manager Interview</strong> (45 mins via Zoom)<br>A conversation with a Hiring Manager focused on your approach to teamwork, client collaboration, and problem-solving in an enterprise development setting. We'll also share more details about Nearform and the potential projects you may join.</p> <p><em>There may also be an additional interview with the client depending on the project</em></p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3><strong>Ready to Join Us?</strong></h3> <p>If you're passionate about building high-quality applications, solving complex challenges, and driving innovation in enterprise development, we’d love to hear from you.</p> <p>Apply now via our careers page at Nearform and be part of a team that values technical excellence, collaboration, and continuous learning.</p> <p><br><br><em>Nearform is committed to shaping a better world in all that we do. Our global team is built based on respect, inclusivity, diversity and excellence.&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>If you require any adjustments to the interview process as part of your application, please let someone from our Talent Team know so they can help.&nbsp;&nbsp;</em></p> <p><em>Salary up to £90,000 + Bonus &amp; Benefits&nbsp;</em><br><br></p> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

By automating workflows, integrating with over 60 tools, and centralizing translation memory and terminology, Lokalise enables product, engineering, and marketing teams to collaborate without friction and launch globally up to 10× faster and at 80% lower cost.

Trusted by thousands of businesses across more than 100 countries, Lokalise empowers millions of people worldwide to use digital services in their native languages. Backed by a customer-loved support team, our platform fits seamlessly into your design, development, and content workflows, helping you scale with consistency and control.

Location

While our company operates exclusively on a remote basis, you must reside and have the legal right to work in one of the following countries: the United Kingdom, Latvia, or Spain.

This is a full-time, remote position. Please note that we do not engage on a B2B or contractor basis. We do not partner with search firms.

 

About the Team

We are looking for a Senior Account Manager to join our EMEA team, which focuses on strengthening relationships with existing customers and driving sustainable revenue growth through retention, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.

In this role, you will own the commercial outcomes and full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts. This includes protecting customer retention, supporting successful renewals, identifying expansion opportunities, and ensuring customers continue to realise value from Lokalise over time.

You will manage a portfolio of strategic customers, with a particular focus on French-speaking stakeholders and organisations. You will act as a trusted commercial partner, helping customers connect Lokalise's capabilities to their business objectives, localisation workflows, and international growth plans.

You will report to the Director of Sales EMEA and work closely with Customer Success, Solutions Architecture, Product, Finance, and Legal. You will be measured primarily on account expansion through upselling, cross-selling, and broader customer adoption and gross revenue retention across your portfolio .

 

What You Will Do

  • Own account commercial outcomes: Take responsibility for the full commercial lifecycle of your assigned enterprise accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.
  • Protect retention and renewal outcomes: Monitor account health, customer engagement, product value, and commercial risks to identify potential retention challenges early and coordinate effective action with internal teams.
  • Drive account expansion: Identify and execute upsell, cross-sell, and expansion opportunities, leading commercial conversations and negotiations with a focus on achieving and surpassing sales quotas.
  • Develop account strategies: Create and maintain clear account plans based on customer goals, stakeholder priorities, product adoption, business risks, renewal plans, and opportunities for broader collaboration.
  • Lead consultative customer conversations: Advise customers on how to improve their localisation and content workflows, connect their needs to Lokalise's solutions, and articulate clear business value and return on investment.
  • Navigate complex enterprise sales processes: Coordinate multi-stakeholder opportunities, procurement activity, contract negotiations, and legal discussions, ensuring progress toward successful commercial outcomes.
  • Partner cross-functionally and maintain accurate reporting: Work closely with Customer Success and Solutions Architecture to support retention and expansion, collaborate with Product, Finance, and Legal to resolve customer needs, and maintain accurate CRM records, account plans, pipeline updates, and forecasts.
  • Use AI to elevate your work: Proactively explore and apply AI tools and approaches to improve customer research, account planning, decision-making, productivity, and go-to-market impact.

 

What You Must Have

  • Full account lifecycle ownership: +5 years of experience owning the commercial lifecycle of strategic or enterprise customer accounts, including retention, renewals, expansion, upselling, and cross-selling in a quota-based B2B SaaS environment.
  • Proven commercial outcomes: A track record of protecting customer revenue, achieving gross revenue retention or comparable retention targets, and generating measurable account expansion.
  • Professional fluency in French, including the ability to lead customer conversations, presentations, and commercial negotiations in French.
  • Ability to understand complex SaaS products, with experience selling to business, marketing, and sales stakeholders, and translating product capabilities into clear commercial value.
  • Strong written and spoken English, with the ability to collaborate effectively across a remote, international organisation.
  • Experience engaging and influencing C-level and senior stakeholders, including the ability to lead strategic conversations and align solutions with business priorities.
  • Strong commercial skills, including experience identifying growth opportunities, negotiating contracts, and navigating complex procurement or legal discussions.
  • Competency using AI tools to accelerate customer research, synthesis, account planning, and decision-making, with a proactive mindset toward adopting new AI-enabled ways of working.

It's a Plus If You Have

  • Experience managing or selling to enterprise customers in the French market, regardless of where you are based.
  • Experience engaging technical stakeholders (e.g., IT, engineering, product) in addition to business buyers.
  • Experience selling localisation, translation management, or other workflow software.
  • Experience working with procurement processes such as RFPs, security reviews, or complex enterprise buying committees.
  • Familiarity with structured sales methodologies or account planning frameworks.

Our Benefits

💰 Competitive salary and employee stock options.

🌍 Fully remote setup with flexible working hours.

🏢 Co-working budget for those days you want a change from your home office.

🌴 Flexible vacation policy to recharge when you need to.

🖥️ Home office setup budget: monitor, desk, ergonomics, whatever helps you do your best work.

📚 Learning & development budget to grow your skills and career.

🏥 Health insurance to keep you covered.

🧘 Wellness allowance to support your mental and physical well-being.

🤝 Great startup culture: remote but close-knit, with regular retreats and social events to stay connected.

 

*Final compensation will depend on location, skills, and experience.

Spain: For this position in Spain, the On-Target Earnings (OTE) range from €76,000–€120,000 (50/50 base and commission split), with uncapped commission potential. The applicable collective agreement is the XIX Convenio colectivo estatal de empresas de consultoría, tecnologías de la información y estudios de mercado y de la opinión pública, under professional classification Area 4 – Group/Level C2.

We are committed to a culture of inclusion and equal opportunities. Therefore, we welcome applications from people of all gender identities, sexual orientations, personal expressions, relationship, marital, or civil partnership statuses, racial identities, national or ethnic origins, religious beliefs, ages, and disability statuses.

Our Telecommunications, Media and Technology team, part of our wider Retail and Consumer unit, is dedicated to guiding our clients on a path to growth in market sectors that have disproportionately been impacted by AI in recent years.

What you'll be doing:

  • Driving revenue growth; identifying strategic opportunities to expand current accounts and identifying new clients within the TMT sector

  • Leading complex AI transformation programmes for major TMT clients, moving from strategic thinking to production-grade software delivery

  • Building trusted, long-term relationships with C-suite leaders and partners, acting as a strategic advisor on how AI can automate knowledge work and drive operational efficiency

  • Generating high-value growth for Faculty by shaping compelling commercial pitches and demos that showcase our technical depth and ability to solve sector-specific challenges

  • Elevating Faculty’s industry profile by articulating differentiated propositions and points of view through thought leadership, media engagement, and industry forums

  • Ensuring the successful delivery of high-quality client work by guiding multidisciplinary teams and helping them navigate the ambiguity and pace of the sector

  • Managing a practice within a practice - leading cross-functional teams of delivery experts, PhD-calibre engineers and data scientists to further consolidate Faculty’s reputation for pioneering technical and delivery excellence.

  • You’ve managed C-level, complex stakeholder relationships in the TMT industry, with a proven track record of building trusted, long-term relationships and navigating strategic commercial conversations with confidence

  • You’re commercially driven - energised by hitting growth targets with a proven track record of shaping opportunities, winning work, and owning meaningful revenue responsibility

  • You are delivery-focused and technically credible, with a track record of translating complex AI concepts with clarity to technical and non-technical audiences

Own signal processing and analysis programmes from research through to validated, production-quality implementations with Software Engineering. raw.title: Senior Finance Business Partner - Marketing (6-month FTC)
raw.description:
About Freetrade

Freetrade’s mission is to become the default place to invest. Investing has been too complicated and expensive for too long, keeping millions from making the most of their savings.

We’re changing that.

We’re building our team and looking for people who are excited to reshape how our customers invest and grow their wealth. If you’re driven by solving complex problems and building innovative products, you’ll fit right in.

2026 is a big year for us. Last year, we announced a game changing deal to become part of the IG Group. We’ll continue to operate as an independent business while gaining access to the resources and support of an established leader in the space.

This year, we’re accelerating our roadmap and taking our products to the next level. We’re building new features like mutual funds, bonds, and family investment tools. We’re also exploring how we can leverage AI to deliver an even better experience for our customers.

Why join the Commercial Finance team at Freetrade?

You will be joining a small Commercial Finance team on a 6-month Fixed Term Contract (FTC) as Freetrade enters the ‘scale-up’ phase of its business. Our team is evolving from an FP&A reporting team to a commercial-oriented business partnering team. You will be providing commercial insight through impactful and insightful analysis to influence executive-level decision-making. You will report to the Head of Commercial Finance.

You will:

  • Partner with our marketing leadership team, along with additional central departments

  • Proactively highlight opportunities for efficiency, evaluating value for money, reviewing paybacks, CACs and ROIs

  • Provide commercial challenge and recommendations, from both data analysis and competitor scanning

  • Seek continuous improvement in reporting, finding areas for automation and opportunities to create self-serve dashboards

  • Own the annual budget for your area along with monthly reporting against budget

  • Forecast headcount spend in partnership with department heads in order to drive hiring decisions

  • Forecast vendor-level spend, track renewal dates and run supplier negotiations

  • Prepare models for business cases, projecting costs and impact for new products, new suppliers and new operations

Experience:

  • Recognised accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CIMA or equivalent) with 5+ years of relevant experience, including 3+ years as a Finance Business Partner.

  • Experience working in financial services/fintech or similar industries

  • Experience of business partnering with a marketing function

  • Experience in building financial models and conducting scenario analysis

About you:

  • A proactive, self-motivated problem solver

  • An effective communicator with the ability to build strong relationships across all levels of the company

  • An interest in the investments industry

  • Highly numerate

Benefits & Logistics

Freetrade is the place to accelerate your career. Our benefits package and ways of working are designed to attract and retain the most talented people who are dedicated to making an impact at Freetrade.

Here’s what’s on offer in 2026:

Hybrid working culture


We’re operating in a hybrid model: 3-days in-office / 2-days from home. We believe great collaboration happens in person and our beautiful offices in central London and Budapest are designed to bring people together.


🏢 Office days: Monday, Tuesday, Thursday
🏡 Work from home days: Wednesday, Friday

This setup helps us stay connected, collaborate more effectively, and keep building a culture where we all do our best work together, including dedicated days for focus work.

Flexibility for those who need it:

We have a hybrid working model, but life happens. If you need flexibility let's talk about it, whether you're a parent or have other care responsibilities.

Values - at Freetrade we live and breathe our values: Honesty, Focus and Grit. Expect to be asked about these in your interview!

Benefits In London:

  • Competitive salary – carefully benchmarked.

  • Holidays – 25 days plus UK public holidays. Your birthday off, plus one extra day for every year at Freetrade.

  • Enhanced pension – We’ll match your contributions up to 7%.

  • Group Life Insurance – Protect your loved ones with coverage at 5x your salary, ensuring financial security in any circumstance.

  • Private Health Insurance - Which includes access to high quality medical care, mental health support, dental and vision plans, Wellness programs and preventative care initiatives are also provided to ensure the wellbeing of your entire family.

  • Bonus Scheme - join us and share in our growth. Bonuses are linked to both company success and your individual impact.

  • Income Protection Cover – Safeguard your income with comprehensive coverage, ensuring financial stability in the event of illness or injury.

  • Enhanced parental leave – Time off when it matters most. ** Eligibility is subject to length of service and statutory requirements.

  • Flexibility for those who need it – We’re office-first, but life happens. Whether you’re a parent or have care responsibilities, we focus on output and trust you to manage your time.

  • Learning & Development – We fund industry qualifications so you can grow as a financial services professional.

  • Cycle to Work scheme – Get a high quality bike and gear through our salary sacrifice scheme, spreading the cost with tax free monthly installments.

  • Paid Sick Leave – Receive 10 days of fully paid sick leave each calendar year.

Interview Process
We keep things simple and transparent. Our process typically includes:

  1. Initial interview – A chat with one of our Talent Partners.

  2. Hiring Manager interview – A deep dive into your skills and experience.

  3. Values interview – A conversation with our stakeholders, where we also assess cultural fit.

We are an Equal Opportunity employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Whatever your race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability - we want to hear from you.

To find out more about how we look after your personal data when you apply for a job with us, please see our Recruitment Privacy Policy here.

Please note we are not accepting agency CVs.

description: <div class="content-intro"><p><strong>Welcome to Planet. We believe in using space to help life on Earth.</strong></p> <p>Planet designs, builds, and operates the largest constellation of imaging satellites in history. This constellation delivers an unprecedented dataset of empirical information via a revolutionary cloud-based platform to authoritative figures in commercial, environmental, and humanitarian sectors. We are both a space company and data company all rolled into one.</p> <p>Customers and users across the globe use Planet's data to develop new technologies, drive revenue, power research, and solve our world’s toughest obstacles.</p> <p>As we control every component of hardware design, manufacturing, data processing, and software engineering, our office is a truly inspiring mix of experts from a variety of domains.</p> <p>We have a people-centric approach toward culture and community and we strive to iterate in a way that puts our team members first and prepares our company for growth. Join Planet and be a part of our mission to change the way people see the world.</p> <p>Planet is a global company with employees working remotely world wide and joining us from offices in San Francisco, Washington DC, Germany, Austria, Slovenia, and The Netherlands.</p></div><p><strong>About the Role:&nbsp;&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>As a Pre-Sales Senior Solutions Architect, you'll design complex solutions that demonstrate the value of Planet's data and services, helping organizations within the UK Defence and Intelligence community overcome critical Earth observation and geospatial challenges. You will act as a trusted advisor and value driver to prospective customers while working closely with product, engineering, and sales teams across Planet to champion customer needs. The ideal candidate, thrives in client-facing environments and has deep familiarity working within the UK Defence and Intelligence sector.</p> <p>This is a full-time, remote position based in the UK. If located near an office, you are expected to work from that office 3 days per week. Up to 25% travel (domestic and international).</p> <p><strong>Impact You’ll Own:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Build trusted advisor relationships with technical, operational, and executive leadership within customer accounts.</li> <li>Lead the technical architecture and end-to-end design of solutions tailored to complex mission and operational requirements.</li> <li>Deliver technical solution demonstrations and presentations, highlighting Planet’s capabilities and value to UK Government and Defence bodies.</li> <li>Facilitate technical workshops for operators and technical stakeholders.</li> <li>Lead the technical responses for tenders, RFIs/RFPs, and unsolicited proposals.</li> <li>Work closely with internal Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to represent customer feedback and inform product roadmap priorities.</li> <li>Attain quarterly and annual sales and operational objectives assigned by management.</li> <li>Represent the needs of Planet's Defence and Intelligence customers to Sales leadership by communicating forecasts, pipeline opportunities, deal reviews, CRM data, and customer feedback.&nbsp;</li> <li>Mentor junior team members and lead internal knowledge-sharing sessions.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Bring:</strong></p> <ul> <li>6+ years of experience supporting the UK Defence and Intelligence community in a technical capacity.</li> <li>Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.</li> <li>Have the ability to obtain and maintain a UK Security Clearance (SC or DV).</li> <li>Deep domain knowledge in Earth Observation, GIS, Remote Sensing, IMINT, and ISR mission workflows.</li> <li>Working experience with ArcGIS, QGIS, SocetGXP, GDAL, Python, and other geospatial software packages and programming languages.</li> <li>Expertise in geospatial system architectures, cloud environments/secure deployments, API integrations, and complex data pipelines.</li> <li>Track record translating customer mission challenges into scalable technical architectures and clear, high-impact demonstrations.</li> <li>Professional working proficiency in English, the language of the company.</li> <li>Willingness and ability to travel up to 25%, including internationally.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What Makes You Stand Out:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Active DV (Developed Vetting) clearance.</li> <li>Direct background as an imagery/geospatial intelligence analyst (IMINT/GEOINT) or operational user within UK MoD or allied intelligence services.</li> <li>Skilled in translating complex customer requirements into compelling, narrative-driven solutions, paired with a natural ability to command the room with senior defence executives, military leaders, and procurement authorities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Application Deadline:</strong></p> <p>11:45p / 23:45 CET on the date stated below. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis. This posting may be removed earlier than projected if a suitable pool of applications has been received. For this reason, we recommend applying as soon as you are able to.</p> <p><strong>Export Control Requirements:</strong></p> <p><em>Planet Labs Germany GmbH is authorized to receive U.S. export-controlled information at Planet under an export license issued by the Bureau of Industry and Security. This position requires access to export-controlled information, and as such, employment (or hiring of a contractor) is contingent upon the candidate’s ability to access all applicable export-controlled information without additional export licensing being required by the Bureau of Industry and Security and/or the Directorate of Defense Trade Controls.</em></p> <p><strong>Benefits While Working at Planet:</strong></p> <p><em>These offerings are dependent on employment type and geographical location, based upon applicable law or company policy.</em></p> <ul> <li>Paid time off including vacation, holidays and company-wide days off&nbsp;</li> <li>Employee Wellness Program&nbsp;</li> <li>Home Office Reimbursement</li> <li>Monthly Phone and Internet Reimbursement</li> <li>Tuition Reimbursement and access to LinkedIn Learning</li> <li>Equity&nbsp;</li> <li>Volunteering Paid Time Off</li> </ul> <p><strong>Compensation:</strong></p> <p>The expected starting gross salary range for this role is listed below. Individual placement within this range is determined objectively based on gender-neutral criteria such as your skills, qualifications, and professional experience. This position may also be eligible for discretionary bonuses and/or equity.</p> <p>In addition to the salary range listed below, this role is also eligible to receive commission.</p> <h6><span style="font-weight: 300; font-family: verdana, geneva, sans-serif;">#LI-REMOTE</span></h6><div class="content-pay-transparency"><div class="pay-input"><div class="title">United Kingdom Salary Range</div><div class="pay-range"><span>£64,540</span><span class="divider">&mdash;</span><span>£80,710 GBP</span></div></div></div><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance<br></strong>Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records.<strong><br></strong></p> <p><strong>Why we care so much about Belonging.&nbsp;<br></strong>We’re dedicated to helping the whole Planet, and to do that we must strive to represent all of it within each of our offices and on all of our teams. raw.title: Director, Strategic Intelligence - 1066
raw.description:
We are seeking a Director, Strategic Intelligence. In this role you will lead Quantinuum's strategic intelligence function, providing forward-looking insights on markets, competitors, customers, technology developments, government policy, investment activity, and broader industry dynamics. 

The Director, Strategic Intelligence is responsible for building and operating an enterprise intelligence capability that enables executives to make informed strategic decisions, anticipate market shifts, identify growth opportunities, mitigate external risks, and strengthen Quantinuum's competitive position. The role serves as the central hub for market intelligence, competitive intelligence, technology monitoring, customer insights, and strategic analysis across hardware, software, cybersecurity, AI, quantum applications, and adjacent markets. 

Key responsibilities 

  • Strategic Intelligence Leadership: Own Quantinuum's enterprise strategic intelligence capability and be accountable for delivering actionable market, competitor, customer, technology, policy, and ecosystem insights that inform executive decision-making, strategic planning, resource allocation, and long-term growth priorities. 

  • Competitive Intelligence: Own the continuous assessment of competitor strategies, product developments, customer activity, partnerships, acquisitions, investments, and market positioning and be accountable for providing executives and business leaders with timely intelligence that strengthens Quantinuum's competitive advantage. 

  • Market & Industry Analysis: Own the analysis of market dynamics, customer adoption trends, growth segments, and emerging opportunities and be accountable for producing data-driven recommendations that influence business strategy, investment priorities, and commercial focus areas. 

  • Technology & Innovation Intelligence: Own the monitoring and assessment of developments across quantum computing, AI, cybersecurity, networking, advanced computing, and adjacent technology sectors and be accountable for identifying opportunities, threats, and strategic implications for Quantinuum's technology roadmap and market position. 

  • Government, Policy & Geopolitical Intelligence: Monitor the evaluation of government policy, regulatory developments, national quantum initiatives, public funding activity, export controls, and geopolitical trends and be accountable for ensuring business leaders understand the strategic implications for growth, partnerships, market access, and risk. 

  • Customer & Ecosystem Insights: Own the development of a structured voice-of-market capability and be accountable for synthesising customer, prospect, partner, investor, analyst, and ecosystem feedback into insights that improve strategic decision-making and market responsiveness. 

  • Executive & Board Decision Support: Own the development of strategic briefings, market assessments, scenario analyses, and executive recommendations and be accountable for providing fact-based intelligence that supports high-quality decision-making by the Executive Team and Board. 

  • Strategic Planning Support: Own the integration of market, competitive, customer, and technology intelligence into strategic planning processes and be accountable for ensuring that annual and long-range plans are informed by robust external insight and evidence. 

  • Strategic Opportunity & Risk Identification: Own the identification and assessment of emerging opportunities, disruptions, threats, and competitive risks and be accountable for ensuring executive leaders are equipped to act proactively rather than reactively to market developments. 

Must Haves 

  • Strategic Intelligence Leadership (10+ years),  Proven experience leading market intelligence, competitive intelligence, strategic planning, corporate strategy, consulting, research, or business intelligence functions in technology, deep-tech, cybersecurity, software, AI, semiconductor, or adjacent industries. 

 

We Value 

  • Competitive & Market Analysis Expertise:  Strong capability in competitor assessment, market analysis, strategic research, industry forecasting, and synthesis of complex external information into actionable business insights. 

  • Executive Communication: Exceptional ability to distil large volumes of technical, commercial, and market information into concise executive-level recommendations and decision-support materials. 

  • Analytical & Problem-Solving Skills:  Demonstrated experience conducting structured analysis, scenario planning, hypothesis-driven problem solving, and strategic assessments. 

  • Cross-Functional Influence: Track record of influencing senior leaders and shaping strategic decisions without direct authority. 

  • Experience in quantum computing, advanced computing, AI, cybersecurity, telecommunications, semiconductors, or other frontier technologies.  

  • Experience within a top-tier strategy consulting firm or a high-growth technology company.  

  • Experience supporting executive leadership teams, CEO staff functions, or Boards.  

  • Exposure to government markets, national security environments, and public-sector technology ecosystems.  

  • Familiarity with M&A strategy, venture capital activity, and technology investment landscapes.  

  • Strong data analytics and intelligence tooling capability. 

 

Quantinuum is a leading quantum computing company delivering a full stack platform designed to make quantum computing deployable in real-world environments. With active engagements spanning pharmaceuticals, material science, financial services, government, industrial sectors, and leading academic and research institutions worldwide, we are helping organizations unlock the transformative potential of quantum computing. 

Our global team of more than 800 employees includes many of the world's leading scientists, engineers, and researchers, with more than 70% of our technology team holding advanced degrees at the Master's or PhD level. Headquartered in Broomfield, Colorado, Quantinuum operates across the United States, United Kingdom, Germany, Japan, and Singapore. 

By joining Quantinuum, you’ll help shape the future of quantum computing, pushing the limits of technology, and making the impossible possible.

Visit our news pages to learn more about Quantinuum and our scientific breakthroughs and achievements:  https://www.quantinuum.com/news
Quantinuum Intro Video: The Future of Quantum Computing

What’s in it for you?

We believe our people are our greatest strength and offer a comprehensive rewards package that supports your professional growth, well-being, and long-term success.

  • Competitive compensation and the opportunity to work on groundbreaking technology
  • Flexible work arrangements that support work-life balance
  • 28 days of annual leave plus bank holidays
  • 4% employer pension contributions
  • Life Insurance
  • Private medical insurance through Bupa
  • Dental Insurance through Bupa
  • Income Protection
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Cycle to work scheme
  • Contribution to eye care
  • Employee Assistance Programme

Equal Opportunity Employer

Quantinuum is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building an inclusive workplace where all employees and applicants are treated with respect and provided equal opportunities regardless of race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, ancestry, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. Know Your Rights: Workplace discrimination is illegal. For more information about Quantinuum, please visit our website. 

We are committed to making our recruitment process accessible to all. If you require any reasonable adjustments at any stage of the application or interview process, please let us know use the Lets talk contact form.

Applications will be accepted on an ongoing basis, there is no application deadline for this position.

title: Senior Manager, Fraud Analytics, OM, UK/EU
description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. With quick onboarding, low fees and innovative features, we thrive on making data driven decisions to serve our mission: to help SMEs save time and money so they can get back to doing what they love.</p> <p><strong>Tide facts:</strong></p> <ul> <li>Tide is available for UK, German and French SMEs</li> <li>Over 2 million members globally and rapidly growing</li> <li>Over $300 million raised in funding</li> <li>3,000 Tideans globally</li> <li>We have offices in Central London, with a member support and technology centre in Sofia, Bulgaria, technology centres in Serbia, Romania, Lithuania and Hyderabad and offices in Gurugram, New Delhi, Berlin, Paris and Luxembourg</li> </ul></div><h3>ABOUT THE TEAM:&nbsp;</h3> <p>At Tide, we are building a finance &amp; admin platform designed to save small businesses time and money. We provide our members with business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of connected administrative solutions from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Launched in 2017, Tide is now the leading business financial platform in the UK with 575,000 SME members (10% market share) and more than 250,000 SMEs in India. Headquartered in London, Tide has over 1,800 Tideans across the UK, Bulgaria, India, Serbia, Romania, Ukraine and Germany.&nbsp;</p> <p>Tide is rapidly growing, expanding into new markets and always looking for passionate and driven people. Join us in our mission to empower small businesses and help them save time and money.</p> <h3>ABOUT THE ROLE:&nbsp;</h3> <p>Exciting opportunity for an experienced leader to work in our Ongoing Monitoring team. As a member of the team, we're looking for someone who is passionate about customer experience and fighting financial crime and wants to help drive our business forward as we continue to grow and expand in new markets. <br><br>Ongoing Monitoring sits in our first line of defence (1LOD) operations’ department, responsible for monitoring the activity of our SME customers (‘members’) for the purpose of preventing, detecting and reporting sanctions, money laundering, terrorism financing, tax evasion, bribery and corruption, money mules and fraud.&nbsp;</p> <p>It's an opportunity to work with an amazing team across multiple geographies, including analysts, team leaders, product and engineering managers, data scientists and operations managers. The role has exposure to many senior stakeholders across the business and is at the heart of what we do to protect our customers.&nbsp;</p> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR:&nbsp;</h3> <ul> <li>Work in a collaborative and cross-functional way to identify, quantify and own complex data driven business decisions to reduce our exposure to fraud</li> <li>As part of the Fraud Analytics programme, use data to balance fraud losses, user friction and regulatory obligations</li> <li>Work collaboratively with a wide range of stakeholders across the entire business to prioritise and translate compliance and business requirements into innovative solutions</li> <li>Identify improvement opportunities to current business processes, create and contribute to the Fraud analytics roadmap</li> <li>Build relationships with leadership and articulate the Fraud Analytics strategy to the business in a structured, data-driven manner - simplifying complex concepts for non-technical audiences</li> <li>Build and lead the day-to-day analytics processes, ensuring Fraud risks are mitigated in an efficient manner and are meeting KPIs</li> <li>7+ years experience in analytics - financial crime experience preferred</li> <li>Strong SQL, excel and visualisation skills (python as well would be preferable) and able to handle complex data structures from multiple sources</li> <li>Experience in rule building, back testing and optimisation</li> <li>Experience of Fraud compliance and regulation</li> <li>Excited about working in a fast-changing environment and have the ability to adapt to the business challenges in front of you</li> <li>Communicating clearly with other parts of the business, explaining financial crime, our processes whilst also managing expectations.</li> <li>Experience building, reviewing, documenting and optimising business processes, isn’t a must have but would be advantageous</li> </ul> <h3>WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN:&nbsp;</h3> <p>Make work, work for you! We are embracing new ways of working and support flexible working arrangements. With our new Hybrid working model &amp; Working Out of Office (WOO) policy our colleagues can work remotely from home or anywhere in their home country. Additionally, you can work from a different country for 90 days of the year. Plus, you’ll get:</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Competitive salary&nbsp;</li> <li>Vitality Health Insurance, with a proactive focus on mental and physical wellbeing</li> <li>Hundreds of perks and discounts through Vitality Health Insurance (fitness watches, Waitrose cashback, gym membership etc.)</li> <li>24/7 Employee Assistance Programme</li> <li>25 days holiday with the ability to buy extra days</li> <li>Professional L&amp;D budget per year</li> <li>Referral bonus when you bring your friends to join Tide&nbsp;</li> <li>Access to ‘salary sacrifice’ benefits such as Cycle to Work scheme and pension contribution</li> <li>Spacious brand new office in Liverpool street with an all-day snacks bar</li> <li>Enhanced family-friendly leave</li> <li>24 hours paid volunteering time off per year</li> <li>Flexible work from home or at the office arrangements</li> <li>Monthly team socials (we’ve had themed bingo, online cocktail making sessions, wellbeing challenges and themed virtual pub quizzes)</li> <li>Sabbatical leave&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h3>TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING</h3> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.&nbsp;</p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. Our offices are designed as hubs for innovation and team-building, where we encourage regular in-person gatherings to foster a strong sense of community.</p> <h3>&nbsp;</h3><div class="content-conclusion"><h3>TIDE IS A PLACE FOR EVERYONE</h3> <p>At Tide, we believe that we can only succeed if we let our differences enrich our culture. Our Tideans come from a variety of backgrounds and experience levels. We celebrate diversity in our workforce as a cornerstone of our success. Our commitment to a broad spectrum of ideas and backgrounds is what enables us to build products that resonate with our members’ diverse needs and lives.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are One Team and foster a transparent and inclusive environment, where everyone’s voice is heard.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p><em>At Tide, we thrive on diversity, embracing various backgrounds and experiences. title: Senior Product Engineer
description: Senior Product Engineer Can you help us fix the world's most broken supply chain? The fashion industry produces over 100 billion garments a year. 60% end up in landfill, not because people don't want these clothes, but because the supply chain for getting secondhand fashion from donation to resale is completely offline, manual, and broken. Fleek is fixing this. Our mission is to make secondhand the first choice . We're building the infrastructure powering the global secondhand clothing trade, through a B2B marketplace and the AI systems digitising the supply chain behind it. Through Fleek, vintage stores, online resellers, and retail buyers source graded secondhand inventory directly from wholesalers and rag houses across multiple countries. Our key enabler is FleekSort, an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, that can grade, price, and categorise items with just a photo, turning what has historically been an opaque and manual trade into a structured, searchable, and tradable global inventory layer. Since 2022, we've saved 9 million items from landfill while tripling in size year-on-year. We're backed by some of the world's best investors, including a16z, Y Combinator, and HV Capital, alongside world-class angels who helped build Depop, Shopify, and Postmates. Today, we serve thousands of resellers and retailers across the UK, Europe, and the US. With the secondhand fashion market projected to reach $350B by 2027, Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for secondhand commerce globally. We're looking for people who want to build something that matters, and move fast doing it. Sound good? Keep reading. About the Role This is a Senior Product Engineer role in Fleek's product engineering team, working across the stack. You'll report into our CTO, Sanket Agarwal (ex-Google, Postmates), and work embedded with a product manager and designer in a small, senior squad focused on the core marketplace experience. Why This Role Stands Out Fleek is digitising an industry that has never had technology. There are no existing playbooks for building an ecommerce experience around secondhand fashion at wholesale scale, where every item is unique, inventory is unpredictable, quality is graded by AI, and the supply chain spans three continents. You will be designing how the transaction layer works for a market that hasn't existed before. You will be on our Growth team, owning the ecommerce journey from discovery to checkout, payment and credit systems, order management, and seller tools. Your systems will handle 500,000+ items a month today and million+ by the end of the year. AI is at the core of everything we do, so you'll work closely with our data and AI teams to build the product features and services that connect FleekSort's classification engine to the marketplace experience. We're looking for a product engineer who can think about how systems affect buyers and sellers at scale. You'll be expected to understand the business problems your code solves, and challenge whether we're solving the right ones. What Makes You a Fleek Product Engineer? Product-Obsessed Builder: You think about what the seller sees when their inventory goes live, or why a buyer drops off at checkout. You instinctively connect technical decisions to commercial outcomes. Comfortable with Ambiguity: We're building systems for workflows that didn't exist before Fleek. You thrive when the problem is undefined and collaboration is key. Customer-Focused Thinker: You understand the dynamics of customer platforms and can understand how technical choices affect customers and our broader marketplace. Owner, Not Renter: You take a feature from problem definition to production and monitor it afterwards. Startup Pace: You've worked in environments where shipping matters more than perfection, where you deploy daily, and where velocity is a competitive advantage. What You'll Do Own the Ecommerce Journey: Design and build the features and systems powering Fleek's core marketplace, across frontend and backend, from item discovery and search through to checkout, payment, and post-purchase. These are product features that directly drive GMV. Integrate AI into the Product: Build the features and services that connect FleekSort's AI classification engine to the marketplace experience, ensuring grading, pricing, and categorisation flow seamlessly into listings, search, and buyer workflows. Design for Scale: Architect systems that handle 500K+ items per month today, with a clear path to millions. Make pragmatic trade-offs between speed of delivery and long-term scalability. Shape Technical Direction: Contribute to architectural decisions across the stack. Challenge assumptions, propose alternatives, and help define engineering standards for a fast-growing team. Mentor and Elevate: Support the growth of more junior engineers through code reviews, pairing, and knowledge sharing. Help raise the technical bar across the team. Collaborate Cross-Functionally: Work embedded with your product manager and designer to define what gets built. Partner with data, AI, and operations teams to turn complex real-world logistics into reliable, scalable software. What You Bring A track record of shipping product: You've built and owned user-facing features end to end, at a marketplace, fintech or consumer company; we care more about what you've shipped than how many years it took. You start from the user: You talk to buyers and sellers, watch where they get stuck, and can explain why what you're building matters to the person using it. You think like a PM: You shape the problem as well as the solution, push back when something doesn't feel right, and tie your work to GMV, conversion or retention. You ship fast and learn: You'd rather put a working version in front of users this week than a perfect one next quarter, and you're used to deploying daily. You measure what you build: You define success before you start and use data, user feedback and experiments to decide what to build next. You build AI-native: You use AI tools every day to move faster, and you've shipped features on LLMs or ML models, with evals to know they work. You work across the stack: You're strong in TypeScript and Node.js and comfortable enough on the frontend and in the data layer to ship a feature end to end, whichever way you lean. You have sound judgement: You make sensible trade-offs between speed and scale, think about failure modes in systems that move real money, and know when good enough is good enough. Nice to Have Experience with marketplace dynamics: two-sided platforms, pricing, trust, supply-demand matching Familiarity with international systems and distributed teams across multiple time zones A genuine excitement for building something from scratch in a category that didn't exist three years ago. This Role Isn't for You If You Want: Narrow, siloed ownership where you only touch one service and never see the user Detailed specs handed to you before you start, we define problems together A slow-moving, highly structured environment with long release cycles Fully remote work, this team is on-site in London 3-4 days per week Pure infrastructure or platform work with no product exposure Ready to build the infrastructure for the world's fastest-growing fashion economy? If you want to work on genuinely hard problems, with a world-class team, at a company that's tripling annually, we'd love to hear from you. The Practicalities Location: London HQ, Commercial St, E1 (Liverpool St / Aldgate East) Work model: On-site Stage: Post-Series B, hyper-growth Team: 100+ across London, India, and Pakistan Stack: TypeScript and Node.js across frontend and backend, AI/ML integration Culture: High ownership, non-hierarchical, fast-moving. Founder-led with strong opinions loosely held. What's In It for You? Fleek is building the AI-native operational and financial backbone for a $350 billion market that has never been digitised. Joining now means you'll be part of the team that defines how the secondhand economy works, at scale, globally. Why people join Fleek The problem is real: 9 million items saved from landfill since 2022. Your work has tangible, measurable impact. The AI is genuinely novel: FleekSort is an AI model fine-tuned on secondhand fashion, turning an opaque manual trade into a structured global inventory layer. This isn't a GPT wrapper. The growth is exceptional: Tripling year-on-year, ~$50M raised, Series B closed. Backed by a16z, Y Combinator, HV Capital, with advisors from Depop, Shopify, and Postmates. The timing is perfect: The secondhand market is projected to reach $350B by 2027. EU regulation is mandating the infrastructure Fleek builds. You're catching a wave. You'll have real ownership: 100-person company, no bureaucracy. You'll shape decisions and see the impact of your work immediately. Our Values Five values shape how we work at Fleek: Dream Big and Disrupt Yourself: Push the most ambitious version of what you're building. Step out of your comfort zone. Nothing is out of reach. Absolute Ownership: The buck stops with you. Drive initiatives to completion. Experiment, learn, persevere. The job isn't done until the job is done. Curiosity Leads the Way: Don't accept anything at face value. Ask questions you don't know the answer to. That's how you innovate. Talk to the Customer: Deeply understand their challenges, motivations, and ambitions. Every decision starts with the customer at the centre. Embrace Diversity: A global team building for a global supply chain. Bring your authentic self and embrace the diversity of everyone you encounter. description: About Level Zero Level Zero is pioneering next-generation biosensor technology for precise, real-time monitoring of critical endocrine biomarkers. Recognised as one of the top 20 startups across all categories worldwide at TechCrunch Disrupt 2024 - and backed by top-tier organisations like SOSV and Entrepreneur First - we’re pushing the boundaries of biochemistry and nanotechnology to revolutionize personalised health. Founded by two seasoned engineers, we bring extensive experience in R&D, technical innovation, and commercial strategy to transform the way people monitor their health. Our mission is bold: to revolutionise health management by delivering clinical-grade data directly to individuals, wherever they are. We’re seeking driven innovators to join us in pushing the boundaries of biosensing and health tech, making personalised health monitoring a reality for everyone. To achieve this ambitious vision, we’re assembling the best team in the world - dedicated to turning cutting-edge science into life-changing, real-world solutions.   About the Role We are seeking a lead biosensor scientist to drive the development and commercialisation of our continuous aptamer sensor platform. The ideal candidate will have proven expertise in developing continuous monitoring devices for regulated healthcare applications, demonstrated experience transitioning research-stage sensors into manufacturing-ready products, and a track record working with in vivo validation studies and large-scale analytical verification programs. This is a full-time, in-person role primarily based in London. What you'll do Lead the development and optimisation of electrochemical continuous sensor systems from bench concept through manufacturing readiness. Design and execute large-scale analytical verification studies, including multi-parameter performance characterisation, stability assessments, and biocompatibility validation. Oversee in vivo validation studies in human subjects and troubleshoot sensor performance in clinical settings. Define manufacturing processes, material specifications, and quality control parameters aligned with regulatory expectations and QMS frameworks. Engage directly with regulatory pathways (FDA, EMA) to define performance specifications and shape submission strategy. Lead cross-functional efforts with electrochemistry, microfabrication, and manufacturing to translate designs into scalable production. Develop technical documentation packages (CMC, analytical performance dossiers) for regulatory submissions and investor communications. Mentor junior scientists and technicians in sensor characterisation and assay validation methodologies. What You Bring A Ph.D. degree in electrochemistry, materials science, biomedical engineering, or related discipline, with specific focus on electrochemical biosensors. Minimum 4 years of industry experience commercialising continuous monitoring or diagnostic sensor technologies. The ideal candidate will possess expertise in the following areas: Deep experience in electrochemical sensor development-particularly amperometric, potentiometric, or impedance-based platforms-with demonstrated progression from research concept to clinical or commercial application. Proven track record managing regulatory submissions (FDA 510(k), De Novo, or CE marking) for continuous monitoring devices. Strong experience designing and executing large-scale analytical verification studies including stability, accuracy, precision, and matrix interference assessments. Demonstrated experience working with in vivo validation studies, including study design, data interpretation, and regulatory reporting. Knowledge of manufacturing readiness, scale-up strategy, and GMP-compatible processes. Proven ability to operate in QMS-ready environments with familiarity of ISO 13485, design controls, and regulatory compliance frameworks. Understanding of biocompatibility, sterility, and shelf-life requirements for implantable or skin-worn continuous devices. Proficiency in surface chemistry, material selection, and biointerface optimisation. Expertise in aptamer-based biorecognition elements and aptamer optimisation for continuous monitoring applications. Nice to have: Experience with microneedle or transdermal ISF technologies. Familiarity with SELEX or aptamer discovery workflows. Experience with MEMS & electrode microfabrication processes. Our passion for excellence drives everything we do, and we welcome individuals who share our commitment to shaping the future. About Orakl Oncology

At Orakl Oncology, we are accelerating the development of oncology treatments. Today, fewer than 5% of new cancer drugs succeed in clinical trials. Clearly, new methods are needed. We combine cutting-edge biology and AI to build the next generation of insight platforms with the world's largest cohort of patient tumor avatars. These avatars fuel our AI-powered predictive engine, helping to anticipate clinical trial outcomes, validate therapies, and uncover new drug candidates. By generating multimodal, real-world data, we deliver insights that consistently outperform existing solutions.

Our mission is simple yet ambitious: to bring more effective treatments to patients who need them - and to make drug development smarter, faster, and more personalized. We collaborate with top hospitals, research institutes, and pharmaceutical companies worldwide. Backed by leading investors, we are a fast-growing, mission-driven startup at the intersection of science and technology.

The company is growing fast, and we are now seeking the best talents to come and join our exciting and ambitious team in the fight against cancer - join us!

Position overview

Orakl runs its data and AI platform on AWS: Dagster pipelines, a versioned PostgreSQL warehouse, ephemeral Fargate and EC2 compute, eight microservices.

Unique in-house and hospital-provided biological, clinical and omics data flow through it every day. We continuously train our proprietary AI models on this every day to create new scientific insights that will benefit patients.

We are hiring a Platform Engineer across three missions: infrastructure, security and scalability. You will be our first dedicated platform hire, and you will decide what this platform looks like for the next years. This is a high-stakes, high-ownership position.

Our stack

  • Cloud: AWS (Paris region), cross-cloud backup to a second European provider

  • Compute: ECS and Fargate, EC2, ephemeral provisioning per job

  • Data: PostgreSQL, S3, versioned transformations

  • Code: Python everywhere, Docker, Terraform, GitHub, GitHub Actions, Dagster orchestration, Nextflow

What you will be doing

1. Security: Codebase, incident management, AI guardrails, fleet management.

These are the main things that you will be focusing during your first months with us:

  • Secure the codebase: workflow permissions, pinned actions, dependency and secret scanning, package security.

  • Run vulnerability watch and build our incident response tooling: establish the blast radius, write the fix, deploy it company-wide, run the postmortem.

  • Define our AI guardrails: we use AI tools heavily and we are embedding them in the product, so we need clear rules on which data those tools may reach and how their output is reviewed before it ships.

  • Develop our fleet management tools to **keep our laptops up-to-date and secure, define and enforce security practices, deploy and maintain management and security tooling to our fleet.

2. Infrastructure management: Compute, data access, observability.

  • Own our AWS compute: VPC and network segmentation, EC2 allocation.

  • Support data storage. As the team and our partner base grow, access to sensitive data has to stay compartmented and auditable. You will be consulted on where data belongs, across RDS, Redshift, PostgreSQL and the rest, and on keeping access to it properly controlled.

  • Build the observability layer: metrics, logs and traces in one place, alerting that fires on real failures.

  • Own secure access to our infrastructure: secure networks, access control and policies, observability.

3. Scalability: Improve the tools we have, choose the ones we will need.

  • Our product is being built and the volume of data coming in keeps growing, which will call for architecture and resources we do not use today. You will be expected to anticipate failures and future needs, and bring your expert knowledge and experience to our systems & designs.

Who you are

Minimum qualifications

  • 5+ years in platform, infrastructure or site reliability engineering, with security a real part of the job rather than an occasional task.

  • Deep hands-on AWS: IAM and identity management, VPC design, RDS, container orchestration, secrets management, federated authentication for CI.

  • Terraform in production with a real review workflow behind it, and containers you have operated rather than only deployed to.

  • Ownership of CI/CD security, ideally GitHub Actions: supply chain integrity, dependency management, build provenance.

  • Incident response as a practitioner. You have been the person on the hook, not the person who read the report afterwards.

  • Fluent in English.

Preferred qualifications

  • Highly sensitive data in a high-stakes regulated sector: health, finance or defence.

  • Working knowledge of French health data regulation (HDS, CNIL, GDPR), or another regulated environment and the appetite to learn this one quickly.

  • Device management at scale (Jamf, Kandji, Fleet or equivalent) and automated joiner, mover and leaver processes.

  • Dagster or a comparable orchestration framework, and PostgreSQL in production.

What we offer

  • Mission: work in a cutting-edge environment, on the forefront of cancer research.

  • Impact: take ownership of a critical piece of an early-stage, fast-moving company, with the opportunity to shape it; your engineering decisions will carry through to our science and, ultimately, to patient outcomes.

  • Team: join a collaborative, multidisciplinary team where you’ll work alongside stellar clinicians, biologists, and engineers towards a common mission.

Interview Process

  1. Hiring Manager Call: Getting to know each other, aligning on expectations and context.

  2. Technical Deep Dive: A deep conversation on your experience relative to the role.

  3. Technical Case: A exercise representative of the real challenges you'll face.

  4. Reference Call: A conversation with several people with whom you've worked closely.

  5. Founder Interview: A final discussion with our founders on vision, culture fit, and mutual ambitions.

👉 More about Orakl here and here

Automating these workflows will be critical to improve the reliability and traceability of experimental work. We are hiring our first automation lead to build the Automation function from scratch. Write user requirement specifications, acceptance criteria and interface requirements for each project. Negotiate price, scope, delivery, acceptance, support and consumables terms autonomously within agreed thresholds. Lead design reviews and factory and site acceptance tests. Translate our proprietary cell culture protocols into automated machine execution with our team of cell biologists and scientists. Track machine availability, hands-on time per line, interventions, failures and recovery time. Use the data to decide the next step. Coordinate with Orakl’s management to anticipate future automation needs on the platform and adjust the roadmap accordingly. Hire and develop the automation technicians and engineers the roadmap needs. Set the standards for the automated platform: documentation, quality control, safety, qualification, change control, vendor management. In this role you will collaborate closely with our cell culture, cell biology and data science teams. You will be at the heart of Orakl Oncology’s capabilities roadmap and help generate unprecedented amounts of biological data to power scientific discovery in cancer. You have experience in communicating and operating with engineers, technicians and workers at the heart of production processes. Autonomy: you tell your manager what you decided and why, not what you need decided. Fluency in English is required. Nice-to-have You have put automated lines, cells or special machines into service end to end: requirements, vendor selection, negotiation, integration, factory and site acceptance, ramp-up, budget. This doesn’t have to be in a lab environment : plant, food and fermentation, pharma or cosmetics are other examples of relevant experience. Automation in life-science or regulated environments: cell culture, biotech, food and fermentation, pharma, cleanroom or BSL-2 work. A working understanding of cell culture and what it demands: sterility, contamination risk, variability between samples, and steps governed by the biological pace. Liquid handling, plate-based workflows, incubators and imagers; laboratory scheduling software. Experience hiring and leading an automation team. description: À propos de UNIK AND CO Unik&Co est un cabinet de recrutement spécialisé dans le recrutement en CDI, CDD et Intérim sur les fonctions supports, financières et supply chain. Basé à Paris, nous pilotons les recrutements sur la France entière pour des acteurs des secteurs de l'Industrie, de la Santé, de la Banque, de l'Assurance, ainsi que du Commerce, du Retail et de la Grande Distribution. Ce que vous ferez Nous recrutons pour un industriel agroalimentaire, un Data Analyst (h/f) dans le cadre d'un CDI. Au sein du pôle Études et Développements applicatifs de la DSI, vous êtes le/la garant(e) de la cohérence, de la fiabilité et de la bonne exploitation des données. Rattaché(e) au responsable du pôle, vous faites le lien entre les besoins des équipes métiers et les plateformes techniques du groupe (SQL Server et Google Cloud Platform) Vos missions s’articulent autour de trois axes : Cohérence, Qualité & Structuration de la Donnée : Garantir la fiabilité et la cohérence des données entre les différentes applications métiers. Mettre en place des contrôles de qualité, documenter les référentiels et cartographier les flux existants. Structurer et modéliser des jeux de données propres et centralisés pour alimenter les tableaux de bord décisionnels et préparer les futurs cas d’usage IA. Création & Suivi des Flux de Données : Concevoir et automatiser les pipelines d’alimentation et de transformation des données depuis les bases internes (SQL Server) vers le Cloud (GCP / BigQuery) Déployer les évolutions en production Assurer la surveillance quotidienne des traitements planifiés, diagnostiquer et résoudre les éventuels incidents pour garantir la fraîcheur des données Accompagnement Métier & Projets IT : Recueillir et cadrer les besoins d’analyse directement auprès des équipes opérationnelles. Épauler les chefs de projet et développeurs de la DSI sur les sujets liés à la donnée afin de maintenir une vision d’ensemble cohérente. Votre environnement de travail : Stack Data : SQL Server (T-SQL), Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Storage), GitHub Environnement applicatif : Échanges réguliers avec les développeurs (.NET / C#) Outils d’IA : Comme l’ensemble de l’équipe IT, vous bénéficiez d’un accès aux outils d’IA générative les plus avancés (ex. Claude par Anthropic, assistants de développement) pour accélérer vos analyses, la création de vos scripts et le contrôle qualité au quotidien. Ce que nous recherchons De formation supérieure (Bac +4/5) en Data ou Informatique, vous justifiez d’une expérience de 3 à 5 ans en Data Analytics, avec un vrai goût pour la technique et l’automatisation Une expérience au sein d’un acteur de la distribution serait un plus Vos compétences techniques : Maîtrise solide du SQL (requêtage complexe, modélisation, optimisation) sur SQL Server et/ou BigQuery (GCP) Capacité à créer des pipelines de données, à les automatiser et à suivre leur exécution en production Connaissance de Git / GitHub et idéalement de Python pour le traitement de données Des notions sur l’écosystème C# / .NET (ou EF Core) sont un plus pour dialoguer avec l’équipe applicative Un esprit analytique rigoureux et une obsession pour la qualité et la cohérence des chiffres Vous aimez comprendre les enjeux métiers et savez vulgariser les sujets techniques Si vous ne remplissez pas l'intégralité de ces critères mais que votre parcours présente des similitudes, nous vous encourageons à candidater. raw.title: Thermal Test and Modelling Engineer
raw.description:
Ready to make connectivity from space universally accessible, secure and actionable? Then you’ve come to the right place!

E-Space is bridging Earth and space to enable hyper-scaled deployments of Internet of Things (IoT) solutions and services. We are building a highly-advanced low Earth orbit (LEO) space system that will fundamentally change the design, economics, manufacturing and service delivery associated with traditional satellite and terrestrial IoT systems.

We’re intentional, we’re unapologetically curious and we’re 100% committed to innovate space-based communications and deliver actionable intelligence that will expand global economies, protect space and our planet and enhance our overall quality of life.


What is the role: 

We are seeking a Thermal Engineer to own the thermal analysis and testing of our space products, such as sensors and actuators. The role centers on building thermal models and correlating them with test data, and on planning and running thermal test campaigns in house. It is a hands-on position: you will instrument and run tests yourself and use the results to improve both the design and our test infrastructure. This position is based in our Toulouse office. 


What you will do:

  • Develop and maintain thermal models (analytical and numerical) of units such as sensors and actuators, from early design trades to flight predictions. 

  • Perform thermal analyses (steady-state, transient, worst-case hot and cold) to support design reviews and recommend design changes. 

  • Define thermal test campaigns: test plans, predictions, temperature profiles, instrumentation, and pass/fail criteria from requirements and qualification margins. 

  • Operate our in-house thermal test facility: run thermal cycling tests, coordinate thermal vacuum (TVAC) campaigns, and own the test reports. 

  • Correlate models with test data to refine predictions and margins and feed the results back into the design. 

  • Improve our test infrastructure: identify capability gaps, specify and procure equipment, design fixtures and thermal interfaces, and commission new setups. 

  • Act as the thermal point of contact for our units toward the spacecraft team: unit thermal budgets, interface boundary conditions, and unit models for the spacecraft thermal model. 

  • Support spacecraft Assembly, Integration, and Test (AIT) through system-level thermal balance testing.


    • What you bring to this role:

  • BS + 8 years / MS + 5 years in Mechanical, Aerospace, or Thermal Engineering, or equivalent, with professional experience in thermal engineering of space or electronic hardware. 

  • Solid grounding in space heat transfer: radiation in vacuum, conduction and contact conductance across bolted interfaces, and multi-layer insulation (MLI). 

  • Hands-on experience building thermal models with standard thermal analysis tools, running worst-case analyses, and correlating models with test data. 

  • Hands-on experience planning and running thermal tests (thermal cycling or TVAC) on space or electronic hardware, from test plan to test report. 

  • Ability to instrument a test article: thermocouple selection and bonding, heater sizing and placement, thermal interface materials, and data acquisition and real-time monitoring, with ESD-safe, clean handling of sensitive hardware. 

  • Excellent teamwork, communication, and documentation skills, with professional proficiency in English; comfortable in a hands-on, fast-paced startup environment.


    • Bonus points:

  • Experience with Python to post-process test data and automate model correlation. 

  • Experience designing or specifying thermal test equipment such as TVAC chambers, thermal plates, or shrouds. 

  • Knowledge of spacecraft thermal control hardware: heat pipes, radiators, coatings, and heater circuits. 

  • Experience using AI/LLM tools to accelerate development, analysis, and documentation, with sound judgment about their limits.

Competitive salary disclosed during the interview process.

Lini is DiliTrust's AI agent, powering Ask Lini, Risk Detector, Document Summarization, Minute Generation, and every AI capability across the suite. We are building a dedicated squad around it and are looking for the engineer who will lead it.

A key part of the role is coordination: you sit at the intersection of ML, product, and feature engineering, and you are accountable for making those conversations productive.

We also care about how you think about AI: whether you approach it as a design question as much as an engineering one, and whether you bring genuine curiosity and opinions into product conversations.

  • Work in close collaboration with the ML team, Product Managers, and feature squads to define and ship Lini features

  • Solid experience with LLM integration patterns in production (RAG, streaming, tool use, context management)

Nos clients ont des systèmes legacy critiques, parfois vieux de 20 ans. Ils veulent les moderniser vite, sans casser ce qui marche. Pour y arriver, un bon outil IA ne suffit pas : il faut quelqu'un sur le terrain, au plus près des équipes du client, qui fait le lien entre leur réalité métier et nos agents et workflows IA. Le Forward Deployed Engineer est ce profil : à moitié ingénieur, à moitié consultant, et toujours responsable du résultat en production.   Ton équipe : Tu rejoins la practice AI Modernisation et tu es détaché chez nos clients.
