Nos clients ont des systèmes legacy critiques, parfois vieux de 20 ans. Ils veulent les moderniser vite, sans casser ce qui marche. Pour y arriver, un bon outil IA ne suffit pas : il faut quelqu'un sur le terrain, au plus près des équipes du client, qui fait le lien entre leur réalité métier et nos agents et workflows IA.
Le Forward Deployed Engineer est ce profil : à moitié ingénieur, à moitié consultant, et toujours responsable du résultat en production.
 
Ton équipe :
Tu rejoins la practice AI Modernisation et tu es détaché chez nos clients. Tu travailles avec un AI Architect, un Tech Lead, des Software Engineers et un Product Manager, et tu t'appuies sur une communauté tech de plus de 350 Theodoers : software engineers, tech leads, engineering managers et architectes.

Tes futures missions
  • Être en immersion chez le client : comprendre son métier, son SI, ses contraintes et ses équipes, et repérer où l'IA a le plus d'impact
  • Déployer et adapter nos workflows IA (agents, LLM, outillage de migration) sur le code et l'infrastructure du client
  • Coder au quotidien : prototyper vite, industrialiser, mettre en production, et ne pas t'arrêter tant que la valeur n'est pas constatée
  • Accélérer la modernisation du legacy : cartographier, refactorer et migrer avec l'IA, avec un haut niveau de qualité (Clean Code, tests automatisés, code reviews)
  • Faire monter en compétence les équipes du client : pair programming, revues de code, transmission des pratiques AI-native
  • Être la voix du terrain : remonter aux équipes produit et aux architectes Theodo ce qui marche et ce qui bloque, pour améliorer nos outils et nos standards
  • Contribuer au business : repérer de nouveaux cas d'usage chez le client et aider à construire les propositions

    • Exemples de projets
  • HealthHero : leader européen de la télémédecine, ils souhaitent moderniser leur plateforme française, Qare, en vue d'une fusion avec la plateforme UK. L'objectif est de passer de Loopback2 à Nest pour pouvoir upgrade de Node 10 vers Node 20. Grâce à notre méthode de modernisation accélérée par l'IA, nous passons d'une estimation à 70 semaines sans IA à une migration terminée en 21 semaines et accélérons la vitesse de delivery par 5.
  • Pernod Ricard : modernisation d'une application interne de gestion des campagnes marketing, avec des millions d'euros en jeu. 23 semaines pour passer de Vue Express à React Nest, et connexion à leur nouvel ERP, auparavant impossible sans la migration.

    • Ce que tu vas apprendre
  • Devenir un ingénieur AI-native de haut niveau, capable de livrer avec l'IA sur des systèmes complexes en conditions réelles
  • Développer une posture de conseil : cadrer un problème, convaincre des décideurs, piloter un changement
  • Maîtriser tout le cycle, de la découverte du besoin jusqu'à la production

    • Tes perspectives d'évolution

  • Avant-vente : Solution Architect
  • Managériale : Engineering Manager

  • À l'aise sur une stack fullstack (Java / Spring Boot, Node / Nest, React / Next, Python) et curieux face aux environnements legacy
  • Orienté client : tu aimes être sur le terrain, tu écoutes, tu reformules, tu sais dire non quand il le faut

  • Exigeant sur la qualité, tu sais arrêter la chaîne quand quelque chose ne va pas (#jidoka)

We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection. As a certified B Corp , we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance. Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries —from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches. We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn , backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started! The Sales Engineer drives revenue growth in the French region while serving as the critical link between market needs, product strategy, and sales team effectiveness. This role balances three core missions: closing new business (primary focus), establishing a product feedback loop, and validating the setup for implementation with integrators. Your Impact at Brevo: Revenue Generation : Partner with Account Executives (typically 3 AEs) to win deals through technical excellence, conducting tailored demonstrations, designing solutions for complex integration requirements, leading technical discovery, and addressing objections throughout the sales cycle. Execute comprehensive deal handoffs to onboarding teams with detailed technical documentation. Product Intelligence & Feedback Loop : Serve as the voice of the market by systematically capturing and communicating insights that shape Brevo's product roadmap. Track and quantify MRR lost due to product limitations or missing features. Participate in regular product feedback sessions with Product Management, providing competitive intelligence, market trend analysis, and feature request prioritization based on revenue impact Product Enablement : Collaborate with the Sales Engineer team to maintain expert-level knowledge of Brevo's products and actively contribute to the team's technical expertise. Share new use cases using recent product releases, product training sessions, create technical sales collateral (demo scripts, integration guides, battle cards), and share best practices from successful customer conversations Design technical solutions addressing API integrations, data flow architecture, CRM system connectivity, and data migration strategies for mid-market (up to 2,000 employees) and enterprise prospects Work closely with integrator partners: collaborate on the scoping of the project, evaluate the effort of implementation, validate the hypothesis of the integrator, bring the technical Product expertise to check the realistic timeline for implementation Develop and deliver enablement content including solution frameworks, technical positioning guides, and objection-handling techniques Monitor industry trends and integration ecosystem developments to ensure Brevo remains competitive in technical capabilities Who you are: 3+ years in SaaS Sales Engineering/Solutions Consulting, supporting complex mid-market and enterprise deals (€5K–€50K MRR). Strong technical skills in marketing automation, API integrations, data modeling, and platform connectivity; able to design end-to-end solutions. Understanding of REST/GraphQL APIs, OAuth/API keys/JWT, and web protocols (HTTP/HTTPS, DNS). CDP experience is a plus. AI enthusiast : proven use of AI skills, agents, illustrate productivity gain with AI, being able to create custom agents to solve recurring pain points. MCP knwoledge is a plus. Proven track record partnering with AEs, supporting multiple reps, and driving high win rates. Experience collaborating with Product to translate market needs, quantify revenue impact, and guide competitive positioning. Experience with integrator partners is a big plus. Excellent communicator able to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value. Analytical, highly organized and self-motivated. Native french speaker; business fluent in English Engineering or business degree with strong technical aptitude (Plus). Why people love working at Brevo: A place to grow, together :  Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighborhood. Practical perks for everyday balance:  RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package (whether you ride a classic bike or go electric, we support your choice to commute greener) and daily Swile meal vouchers (€ 12.50/day) . Learning, every step of the way:  Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support. Flexible for life :  A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents. Wellbeing that works :  Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick and needs you, and Several services related to prevention, health and personal and professional well-being on Welii platform A culture that cares :  From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You’ll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto, all here to support what matters to you, inside and outside of work. At Brevo, we’re not just building a CRM. With our technology, we’re helping millions of organizations build lasting relationships with their customers.

From emails and SMS to WhatsApp, Chat, and Marketing Automation, our tools are intuitive, powerful, and built to scale with every ambition. We give businesses a clear view of the customer journey, so they can focus on what matters: connection.

As a certified B Corp, we’re proud to grow with purpose, committed to high standards of social and environmental impact, not just performance.

Today, more than 500,000 businesses across 180 countries—from NGOs like Amnesty International to global brands like Carrefour, eBay, Louis Vuitton, and Michelin—trust Brevo to engage their audiences, cut through complexity, and deliver results. Our reliable technology and 75+ integrations help them create unparalleled customer experiences, without the usual tech headaches.

We recently exceeded 200m ARR and reached a major milestone by becoming a Unicorn, backed by strong growth and global expansion - and we’re just getting started!

The Sales Engineer drives revenue growth in the French region while serving as the critical link between market needs, product strategy, and sales team effectiveness. This role balances three core missions: closing new business (primary focus), establishing a product feedback loop, and validating the setup for implementation with integrators.

Your Impact at Brevo:
  • Revenue Generation: Partner with Account Executives (typically 3 AEs) to win deals through technical excellence, conducting tailored demonstrations, designing solutions for complex integration requirements, leading technical discovery, and addressing objections throughout the sales cycle. Execute comprehensive deal handoffs to onboarding teams with detailed technical documentation.
  • Product Intelligence & Feedback Loop: Serve as the voice of the market by systematically capturing and communicating insights that shape Brevo's product roadmap. Track and quantify MRR lost due to product limitations or missing features. Participate in regular product feedback sessions with Product Management, providing competitive intelligence, market trend analysis, and feature request prioritization based on revenue impact
  • Product Enablement: Collaborate with the Sales Engineer team to maintain expert-level knowledge of Brevo's products and actively contribute to the team's technical expertise. Share new use cases using recent product releases, product training sessions, create technical sales collateral (demo scripts, integration guides, battle cards), and share best practices from successful customer conversations
  • Design technical solutions addressing API integrations, data flow architecture, CRM system connectivity, and data migration strategies for mid-market (up to 2,000 employees) and enterprise prospects
  • Work closely with integrator partners: collaborate on the scoping of the project, evaluate the effort of implementation, validate the hypothesis of the integrator, bring the technical Product expertise to check the realistic timeline for implementation
  • Develop and deliver enablement content including solution frameworks, technical positioning guides, and objection-handling techniques
  • Monitor industry trends and integration ecosystem developments to ensure Brevo remains competitive in technical capabilities

    • Who you are:
  • 3+ years in SaaS Sales Engineering/Solutions Consulting, supporting complex mid-market and enterprise deals (€5K–€50K MRR).
  • Strong technical skills in marketing automation, API integrations, data modeling, and platform connectivity; able to design end-to-end solutions.
  • Understanding of REST/GraphQL APIs, OAuth/API keys/JWT, and web protocols (HTTP/HTTPS, DNS). CDP experience is a plus.
  • AI enthusiast : proven use of AI skills, agents, illustrate productivity gain with AI, being able to create custom agents to solve recurring pain points. MCP knwoledge is a plus.
  • Proven track record partnering with AEs, supporting multiple reps, and driving high win rates.
  • Experience collaborating with Product to translate market needs, quantify revenue impact, and guide competitive positioning.
  • Experience with integrator partners is a big plus.
  • Excellent communicator able to translate complex technical concepts into clear business value.
  • Analytical, highly organized and self-motivated.
  • Native french speaker; business fluent in English
  • Engineering or business degree with strong technical aptitude (Plus).

    • Why people love working at Brevo:
  • A place to grow, together : Join an international team in a bright, collaborative office located in a vibrant neighborhood.
  • Practical perks for everyday balance: RTT days off, 50% public transport reimbursement, Sustainable Mobility Package (whether you ride a classic bike or go electric, we support your choice to commute greener) and daily Swile meal vouchers (€12.50/day).
  • Learning, every step of the way: Access to English classes and 155,000+ courses on Udemy, plus a strong internal culture of knowledge-sharing and support.
  • Flexible for life : A remote-friendly setup, budget to support your home workspace, and relocation assistance for international talents.
  • Wellbeing that works : Top-notch private healthcare (70% covered), 6-week second-parent leave, extra time off if your child is sick and needs you, and Several services related to prevention, health and personal and professional well-being on Welii platform
  • A culture that cares : From inter-office trips to regular team events, there are plenty of ways to connect beyond your day-to-day. You’ll also find active social, green, and LGBTQIA+ communities, plus Work Council benefits via Leeto, all here to support what matters to you, inside and outside of work.

    • Our candidate journey:
  • Introductory TA call (30 min)
  • Hiring Manager Interview
  • Case Study
  • Final interview with VP Revenue Operations (30 min)
    • Whoever you are, wherever you’re from, if this role speaks to you, we’d love to hear from you.

High Stakes, High Reward: Manage 5-10 accounts where your impact is visible and your commission is uncapped based on performance. Prestige & Growth: Work at the intersection of a top-tier consultancy and a disruptive software editor. The Deep Dive: Interview with the Head of Sales/Founders to discuss your past quotas, your specific Telco "war stories," and your RFP track record . title: Doubletrade - Responsable Commercial / Account Executive - Tertiaire (H/F) - Cdi
description: Responsable commercial (H/F) CDI Rejoignez le Groupe INTESCIA, leader de la Business Intelligence en Europe ! Qui sommes-nous ? DOUBLETRADE , filiale du groupe INTESCIA , est une entreprise innovante spécialisée dans la data et la Business Intelligence. Nous offrons des solutions performantes et sur-mesure pour booster la réussite commerciale de nos clients, notamment dans le domaine des marchés publics. Forts de notre expertise en science des données et en intelligence artificielle, nous accompagnons nos clients dans la transformation numérique et la prise de décision stratégique. Nos atouts : Un groupe en pleine expansion, reconnu pour son expertise et ses solutions à forte valeur ajoutée. Une culture d’innovation, où la créativité et l’amélioration continue sont au cœur de notre ADN. Des équipes passionnées et engagées, évoluant dans un environnement stimulant et collaboratif. Votre mission : Développer le portefeuille de nouveaux clients (principalement des clients du services tertiaires comme les assurances, banques, formations, ingénieurs, IT…) en pilotant l'ensemble du cycle de vente, de l'identification des opportunités jusqu'à la signature des contrats. Vous êtes un acteur clé de notre croissance en conquérant de nouveaux marchés et en transformant les leads en clients. Vos activités : Identifier, prospecter et conquérir de nouveaux clients grâce à une démarche proactive. Qualifier et traiter les leads générés par les équipes Marketing et SDR/Téléprospection. Comprendre les enjeux des prospects afin de construire des propositions de valeur adaptées. Piloter l'ensemble du cycle de vente : découverte, démonstration, négociation et closing. Collaborer avec les équipes Tech et Data pour concevoir des solutions répondant aux besoins des prospects. Assurer une veille concurrentielle et identifier de nouvelles opportunités de développement. Contribuer à l'amélioration continue de notre approche commerciale et partager les bonnes pratiques. Le profil que nous recherchons : Vous êtes un véritable développeur commercial, motivé par la conquête et les challenges. Vous aimez ouvrir de nouveaux comptes, créer des opportunités et dépasser vos objectifs. Expérience : Expérience significative (3 à 5 ans) en vente BtoB, idéalement dans les secteurs des services tertiaires et/ou à minima dans la technologie et la data, avec une forte dominante en acquisition de nouveaux clients. Analyses et support aux équipes •       Livrer les cockpits portefeuille des Account Managers : comptes à risque, échéances, opportunités d'upsell. •         Produire les analyses ad hoc demandées par le Head of RevOps : conversion, cycle de vente, couverture pipeline, cohortes de churn. Le profil que nous recherchons : Expérience •       3 à 5 ans en RevOps, Sales Ops, Business Analytics ou data, dont au moins 2 dans un éditeur SaaS ou un modèle par abonnement. •       Expérience concrète d'administration Salesforce, obligatoire ; HubSpot fortement apprécié. Expérience de construction de reporting ARR. •       Un plus : contexte multi-entités ou harmonisation de données hétérogènes après acquisition. description: <div class="content-intro"><h3>Our Purpose<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>At SentinelOne, we are driven by a clear purpose: to give the advantage to those who secure our future. As AI reshapes how organizations build, operate, and innovate, the responsibility to protect them becomes more critical than ever. When you join SentinelOne, your work helps protect global enterprises, critical infrastructure, and the technologies shaping tomorrow. If you are motivated by meaningful challenges and want your impact to be real, measurable, and global, you will find purpose here.</p> <h3>About Us<strong><br></strong></h3> <p>SentinelOne is a company at the intersection of AI and security, pioneering a new operating model for cybersecurity. Our AI-native platform unifies protection across endpoint, cloud, identity, data, and AI systems to deliver autonomous detection and response with clarity and speed. By combining real-time analytics, intelligent automation, and a unified data foundation, we reduce noise, simplify complexity, and empower security teams to focus on what truly matters.</p> <p>Our teams are builders, problem-solvers, and innovators committed to shaping the future of security. If you are excited to solve hard problems alongside talented, mission-driven people, we invite you to help us build a safer future for humanity.</p> <h3><strong>What Are We Looking For?</strong></h3> <p>We’re looking for people who are relentlessly curious and committed to continuous learning. AI is reshaping every function across our business, and we enable every team member, regardless of role or level, to build fluency in AI tools and concepts. Those who thrive here actively seek out new solutions, experiment thoughtfully, and apply what they learn to drive better, faster, smarter outcomes.</p></div><p><span data-sheets-root="1">As a Windows Low Level Engineer - Endpoint security, you will design and develop advanced security features for SentinelOne’s Windows endpoint protection platform, operating across both user-mode and kernel-mode environments. You will build and optimize mission-critical components including anti-tampering protections, network sensors, and agent infrastructure while solving complex performance and stability challenges at massive scale. By researching Windows internals and debugging deep system issues, you will collaborate with distributed engineering teams to deliver high-impact security capabilities protecting millions of devices worldwide.</span></p> <p>We are seeking a highly skilled and experienced Software Engineer with a strong background in low-level C++ programming and a deep understanding of Windows OS, to help us in developing our <strong>Endpoint Protection product</strong>, the core part of our business, and to join one of our Platform group teams. (<strong>We're currently growing multiple teams</strong> and are open to new colleagues with a wide variety of backgrounds within Windows development!).</p> <p>The <strong>Platform group</strong> teams are in charge of some of our most complex low-level areas, such as:</p> <ul> <li>Windows agent’s Anti-Tampering (self-protection from malware attempting to harm the agent), network sensors, device control, and other kernel-side features involving both research and development,</li> <li>usermode security &amp; agent infrastructures - e.g. installers, logging, services such as communication layer &amp; interfaces for our Windows agent, for improving the quality, performance &amp; stability of the agent and making the user experience smoother.</li> </ul> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">By joining our group, you will collaborate with talented engineers who are leading a feature through the whole development lifecycle. Your work will have an impact on millions of endpoints in one of the mainstream areas of the<a href="https://s1.ai/endpoint" target="_blank"> EPP/EDR agent of SentinelOne</a> - a product recognized 5x-in-a-row as Gartner MQ Leader, scoring highly in many MITRE Att&amp;ck assessments, valued by users in Gartner Peer Insights and more.</span></p> <h3><strong>What will you do?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>As a new member of one of our distributed development teams, you will work in both user-mode &amp; kernel-mode, and deal with a large variety of fields.</li> <li>You will have the chance to design, develop primarily in modern C++ (23), test and debug the most complicated real-world problems (often unseen before). In order to successfully deal with this challenge, you will continuously enrich your knowledge and experience with Windows OS internals &amp; Kernel, Endpoint Protection, and Endpoint Detection &amp; Response eco-system.</li> <li>Our teams design and execute significant new features, as well as rewrite and reimplement the existing ones from scratch. You will also deal with extraordinary performance &amp; optimization challenges, given the scale of our cybersecurity SW (handling hundreds of billions of events every day).</li> <li>Your work will influence the security of tens of millions of Windows devices, that we protect at enterprise &amp; government customers across the globe (incl. 4 of Fortune 10 and hundreds of Global 2000).</li> <li>You’ll also be encouraged to share knowledge within both Platform teams and the broader Windows group.</li> <li><strong>Working setup:</strong> Flexible working hours, this is a 100% remote role on full-time permanent employment based within France. We provide optional membership in major coworking chains. Currently for this role in France we are able to consider only candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying. Optionally for those willing to relocate to the Czech Republic relocation assistance is available for any candidates that are already eligible to work in the EU at the time of applying.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>What skills &amp; knowledge should you bring?</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Multiple years of experience as a software engineer in the area of lowlevel programming using modern C++ (or using C and a willingness to learn modern C++)</li> <li>Hands-on experience and in-depth understanding of Windows OS design &amp; internals, Windows low-level development, with debugging of Windows applications and familiarity with related standard debugging and profiling tools</li> <li>Previous experience working on a production-grade product with a wide-scale deployment</li> <li>Great communication skills and the ability to work both independently and with peers from different time zones, problem-solving and out-of-the-box thinking</li> <li>Attention to detail and high coding standards</li> <li>An advantage: experience with Windows Kernel and Windows Drivers development, experience in security-oriented development, with reversing or malware analysis</li> </ul> <h3><strong>Why SentinelOne?</strong></h3> <p>AI is redefining how the world operates and rewriting the rules of security in real time, and SentinelOne was built for this moment. From day one, we architected an AI-native platform designed to operate at machine speed, not as an add-on to legacy systems but as the foundation itself. If you want to build where innovation and impact move together, this is that place.</p> <p>We invest in our Sentinels with comprehensive, competitive benefits designed to support you and your family:</p> <p><strong>Equity &amp; Rewards</strong></p> <ul> <li>Restricted Stock Units (RSUs)</li> <li>Employee Stock Purchase Plan (ESPP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Time Off &amp; Wellbeing</strong></p> <ul> <li>Competitive leave benefits</li> <li>Gender-neutral parental leave</li> </ul> <p><strong>Insurance &amp; Financial Security</strong></p> <ul> <li>Medical and insurance benefits</li> <li>Disability insurance</li> <li>Employee Assistance Program (EAP)</li> </ul> <p><strong>Work Perks &amp; Flexibility</strong></p> <ul> <li>Global home office allowance</li> <li>Mobile phone reimbursement</li> <li>Work-from-home allowance</li> </ul><div class="content-conclusion"><p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne is proud to be an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, gender (including pregnancy, childbirth, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.</span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">SentinelOne participates in the E-Verify Program for all U.S. based roles.&nbsp;</span></p> <p data-pm-slice="1 1 []">To learn more about how we use AI in our hiring process, please review our&nbsp;<a href="https://assets.contentstack.io/v3/assets/blt53c99b43892c2378/bltca86b3b84e902400/AI-in-Hiring-SentinelOne.pdf">AI in Hiring Candidate Disclosure</a>.</p></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in France on Arbeitnow

description: Most CFOs inherit a finance function. This one gets to build it. quinn is an app-based, managed payroll and employment-administration service. We run it for private households employing a cleaner, nanny, or caretaker, and for businesses that manage employment relationships at scale. The customer stays the legal employer — quinn registers the employment, runs payroll, and handles social insurance, taxes, and filings on their behalf, automated end to end. The next is a world model across every site that predicts the next state in latent space, starting from open world-model weights and growing on field data nobody else holds. Anomaly as surprise: replace rule-based alerting with measured surprise, and work out how to evaluate it when real incidents are rare. World model: post-train open world-model weights on aligned multi-sensor field sequences, JEPA-style, predicting in latent space rather than pixels. Transfer: from one site's memory to a model of all of them, and representations that carry across sites and domains. Research direction: choose the questions, design the experiments, and decide what is true before it ships. Our robots patrol security sites, critical infrastructure and defence facilities without a human present, so a bad release is not a rollback: it is a customer incident. Within six months, nothing should reach a customer robot without passing something you built. What You'll Work On Release pipeline: code change, automated tests, simulation at scale, staging robot, pilot site, full rollout, with explicit pass criteria at every gate and nothing advancing without meeting them. Simulation as infrastructure: a GPU-backed simulation environment (Isaac Sim today) running continuously, so engineers test against scenarios instead of queueing for the one robot in the lab. Scenario libraries and regression suites: coverage across the whole on-robot stack, perception through locomotion, and the infrastructure to run thousands of scenarios on every change. Hardware-in-the-loop: bench rigs and test procedures on the physical robots for what simulation cannot tell you. Failure injection: drop sensors, degrade LiDAR returns, kill the network link, corrupt odometry, then verify the system degrades and recovers the way we tell customers it does. Field incidents to tests: when a robot misbehaves on site, reproduce it deterministically and turn it into a permanent regression test. Reproducibility: log capture, replay tooling, deterministic seeds, versioned scenarios, and coverage metrics that are honest about what they do not cover. Acceptance criteria: turn product and customer requirements into measurable tests, and report against them without softening the numbers. title: Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer
description: <p>Auterion builds a cutting-edge operating system for autonomous robotic systems that empower a diverse range of platforms to perform surveillance, reconnaissance, inspection, mapping and logistics tasks. Our industry-leading software drives the adoption of robotic fleets and is recognized by the U.S. government as the future standard for its drone programs.&nbsp;</p> <p>We are looking for a Senior Embedded Linux Software Engineer taking on tasks within the AuterionOS ecosystem, from writing applications to adding driver support for new peripherals, maintaining system services and optimizing performance on embedded platforms. You will be working closely with:</p> <ul> <li>Linux running on embedded hardware</li> <li>C/C++, Python &amp; Bash codebases</li> <li>Engaged and friendly engineers from across Auterion</li> </ul> <p><strong>Responsibilities</strong></p> <ul> <li>Work within the Board Support team and collaborate with other development teams to build leading-edge products.</li> <li>Add features, solve bugs, write tests and improve the performance of software components running on AuterionOS, Auterion’s custom embedded Linux distribution.</li> <li>Collaborate with engineering and product teams to understand both internal and customer use cases.</li> <li>Propose new software solutions and take ownership of the implementation. Your technical expertise will have a huge impact on bringing Auterion’s drone products to market.</li> <li>Provide expert support (L3) to customers facing technical issues.</li> <li>Write clear and concise internal documentation, in addition to contributing to the public-facing knowledge base.</li> <li>Participate in daily stand-ups, as well as release planning and task prioritization meetings.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Qualifications and Skills</strong></p> <ul> <li>B.Sc./M.Sc. in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or related fields.</li> <li>3+ years of experience writing object-oriented C++ and/or Python code in a professional setting.</li> <li>Extensive experience working with embedded architectures, including cross-compilation, debugging, and performance optimization.</li> <li>Expert Linux skills, with an excellent grasp of command line operations, resource management, systems services and networking.</li> <li>Deep knowledge of the Linux kernel, embedded device drivers, device tree configuration and u-boot.</li> <li>Experience with Debian/Ubuntu-based systems, Debian packaging workflows and managing complex Docker environments.</li> <li>Knowledge of OTA updates (e.g. mender).</li> <li>Proficient in networking concepts across all layers of the OSI model, including connectors, and hardware interfaces, IP addressing, routing protocols, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, etc.</li> <li>Skilled in using network diagnostic tools (e.g., Wireshark, tcpdump) to identify and resolve network issues.</li> <li>Basic embedded security knowledge, such as secure boot on embedded devices and/or UEFI, boot chain verification.</li> <li>Proven experience with network security protocols (e.g., SSL/TLS, VPNs) and best practices for securing embedded devices, such as secure boot and encryption mechanisms.</li> <li>Basic electrical engineering experience, such as familiarity with schematics and the instrumentation required to debug communication over I2C, SPI, UART, CAN bus.</li> <li>Bonus: Experience with video streaming and MIPI CSI drivers.</li> <li>Bonus: Experience with NVIDIA Jetson platforms and their associated BSP packages.</li> <li>Bonus: Experience with NXP iMX8 platforms and their associated BSP packages.</li> <li>Bonus: Previous contributions to open source projects, especially in the Linux ecosystem.</li> <li>Bonus: Experience with CI/CD systems, such as Jenkins, GitHub actions, GitLab CI.</li> <li>Experience working in an agile environment, providing daily updates in stand-ups and managing tasks in a sprint board.</li> <li>A product-oriented mindset, with an eagerness to drive forward project initiatives.</li> <li>EU Citizenship required.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Flexible working hours</li> <li>Stock Options</li> <li>Generous holiday allowance</li> <li>Company pension plan&nbsp;</li> <li>Car parking&nbsp;&nbsp;</li> <li>Enhanced maternity &amp; paternity leave</li> <li>Mental health and wellbeing support</li> <li>Learning and development opportunities</li> </ul> <p><strong>About Auterion</strong></p> <p>We are building the leading software platform for AI-powered autonomous systems for enterprise and government customers. Our team is supporting the most important missions and solving the most challenging problems.</p> <p>At Auterion, we bring together the sharpest minds who love to solve the hardest problems. Join a vibrant team built on innovation, openness, and excellence, where you’ll be empowered to develop ideas, collaborate across all levels, and make an impact that matters.</p> Find more English Speaking Jobs in Switzerland on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Customer Success Manager (Dutch speaking/ Nederlandstalig)
description: Over de rol 🎯 Als Senior Customer Success Manager bij DataSnipper zorg je ervoor dat onze klanten hun doelen bereiken met onze innovatieve, AI-gedreven oplossingen. Je bent verantwoordelijk voor de klantreis, van onboarding tot langdurige waardecreatie en retentie, en bouwt sterke relaties op basis van vertrouwen en samenwerking. Je helpt klanten sneller waarde te halen uit onze producten en draagt bij aan de groei en het succes van ons bedrijf. Deze rol biedt een unieke kans om nauw samen te werken met professionals die de wereldwijde kapitaalmarkten draaiende houden, door uitzonderlijke service te leveren en een actieve en betrokken community voor onze klanten op te bouwen. Word jij enthousiast van Customer Success en pak je graag zelf de regie? Dan horen we graag van je! Over DataSnipper Wij geloven dat vertrouwen essentieel is voor hoe de samenleving werkt. Elke dag vertrouwen we op informatie die onafhankelijk is gecontroleerd, van jaarrekeningen tot de producten die we kopen en de duurzaamheidsclaims van bedrijven. Achter dat vertrouwen staan audit- en financeprofessionals die bewijs onderzoeken, informatie verifiëren en organisaties ter verantwoording roepen. Bij DataSnipper bouwen we AI-oplossingen waarmee deze professionals die beoordelingen kunnen maken. Met Alwin by DataSnipper, ons nieuwe agentic platform, nemen AI-agents audit- en financeprocedures van begin tot eind over, terwijl elke conclusie terug te voeren is op de bron. Zo houden professionals ruimte voor het oordeelsvermogen en de expertise die hun werk zo belangrijk maken. Meer dan 600.000 professionals bij ruim 3.000 organisaties in 175 landen vertrouwen op ons platform. Daaronder vallen Fortune 500-bedrijven, overheidsinstanties en alle Big Four-accountantskantoren. Alleen al in 2025 leverde DataSnipper zijn klanten een productiviteitswinst op ter waarde van meer dan 1,4 miljard dollar. Met een Series B-financieringsronde van 100 miljoen dollar onder leiding van Index Ventures, bij een waardering van 1 miljard dollar, leggen we een solide basis voor onze volgende groeifase. Als lid van 1% for the Planet kijken we niet alleen naar hoe snel we groeien, maar ook naar hoe we groeien. Voor onze Customer Success-teams wordt het nu extra spannend. Alwin is net gelanceerd, de vraag groeit en we breiden uit naar nieuwe markten en segmenten. Met een product waar klanten al op vertrouwen, heb je de kans om echt je stempel te drukken op de volgende stap. Wat ga je doen Trusted Advisor zijn: Je bent een strategische partner voor belangrijke beslissers, zoals auditpartners en -managers, controllers, finance directors en IT-besluitvormers, en begeleidt hen bij de transformatie van hun organisatie met DataSnipper. Business transformatie aanjagen: Je helpt klanten hun workflows en processen opnieuw uit te vinden en laat zien hoe de AI-mogelijkheden van DataSnipper meetbaar bijdragen aan efficiëntie, kostenbesparing en kwaliteit binnen audit en finance. Strategische, consultatieve oplossingen bieden: Je denkt mee over de uitdagingen van elke klant en vertaalt dat naar praktisch advies, zodat zij hun audit- en financeworkflows optimaliseren en hun strategische doelen bereiken met DataSnipper. Klanten helpen om meer waarde uit DataSnipper te halen: Je geeft uitgebreide trainingen, organiseert regelmatige Business Reviews en ontwikkelt succesplannen, zodat klanten de functionaliteiten van DataSnipper omarmen en aantoonbare waarde halen uit ons platform. Hechte klantrelaties opbouwen: Je bouwt sterke, langdurige partnerschappen op basis van vertrouwen, diepgaand inzicht in de sector en oprechte betrokkenheid bij het succes en de resultaten van je klanten. Over teams heen samenwerken: Je werkt samen met Product, Engineering, Sales en Solutions Engineering en deelt klantinzichten over workflowuitdagingen, use cases en technische vereisten om productinnovatie te stimuleren. De stem van je klant zijn binnen DataSnipper: Je begrijpt de auditmethodologie, compliance-eisen en bedrijfsdoelen van je klanten goed en geeft feedback intern door, zodat DataSnipper antwoord geeft op echte behoeften uit de praktijk. Strategische groei ondersteunen: Je signaleert en realiseert uitbreidingskansen binnen je portefeuille. Samen met Sales toon je de ROI aan, faciliteer je pilots en vergroot je de adoptie binnen teams en service lines. Zorgen voor soepele technische implementatie en fungeren als platformexpert: Je ondersteunt klanten bij onboarding, inclusief setup, AI-configuratie en het op maat maken van workflows, en blijft up-to-date met het platform van DataSnipper, de AI-mogelijkheden en best practices voor automatisering. Strategische sessies leiden: Je plant en faciliteert persoonlijke en virtuele sessies met audit- en financeteams om adoptie te stimuleren. Daarnaast deel je best practices voor een succesvolle transformatie en pak je uitdagingen aan die het klantbehoud in gevaar kunnen brengen. Heldere succesplannen opstellen: Je maakt strategische roadmaps voor elke klant met transformatiedoelen, adoptiemijlpalen, uitbreidingskansen, engagementtactieken en succesmetrics. Health en business impact monitoren: Je volgt en voorspelt belangrijke metrics, zoals gebruikersengagement, featuregebruik, geleverde bedrijfswaarde, uitbreidingskansen, retentierisico's en technische health-indicatoren. Wat breng je mee Customer Success-ervaring: Minimaal 5 jaar ervaring in Customer Success, Account Management, Solutions Consulting of een andere customer-facing functie in B2B SaaS, met een goed begrip van de customer success-aanpak (onboarding, adoptie, verlengingen en uitbreiding). Trusted Advisor-mindset: Passie om een strategische partner voor klanten te zijn, duurzame relaties op basis van vertrouwen op te bouwen en transformatie aan te jagen die uitzonderlijke waarde levert. Focus op business transformatie: Aantoonbaar vermogen om klanten te helpen hun processen en workflows opnieuw te bekijken en te laten zien hoe technologie meetbare bedrijfsresultaten oplevert. Verantwoordelijkheid en ownership: Een sterk gevoel van ownership en de drive om je vak te beheersen, initiatief te nemen en te zorgen dat geen details over het hoofd worden gezien. Samenwerkingsgeest: Je werkt graag samen met andere teams en bouwt waardevolle partnerschappen op met klanten en interne stakeholders. Flexibiliteit en groeimindset: Je leert snel en voelt je thuis in een dynamische omgeving met een hoog tempo, waarin klantbehoeften en prioriteiten blijven veranderen. Uitstekende communicatie: Professionele beheersing van het Engels en Nederlands is een must. Auditachtergrond: Werkervaring binnen externe of interne audit of assurance is een pre. Wat bieden wij Je maakt deel uit van een van de snelstgroeiende, winstgevende unicorn-scale-ups van Nederland met wereldwijde impact. Equity (Stock Appreciation Rights), zodat je meedeelt in het succes en de groei van het bedrijf. Een pensioenregeling met een bijdrage van 6% bovenop je basissalaris. 28 vakantiedagen per jaar (fulltime) voor een goede werk-privébalans. Hybride werken, met minimaal 3 dagen per week op kantoor in ons dynamische kantoor in Amsterdam. Dagelijks vers bereide lunches om je energiek te houden. Een NS Business Card voor makkelijk reizen naar kantoor. Een gestructureerd onboardingprogramma waarmee je een sterke start maakt, inclusief gereserveerde tijd om ons product en onze klanten te leren kennen voordat je écht begint. Toegang tot doorlopende leer- en ontwikkelinitiatieven om je vaardigheden te laten groeien. Werk samen met een levendig internationaal team verspreid over zeven kantoren wereldwijd. Bedrijfsbrede events zoals DataSnipper GO, waar teams van over de hele wereld samenkomen. Toegang tot Nilo, een platform voor mentale gezondheid en welzijn. Sollicitatieproces Recruiter screening (30 minuten, online) Gesprek met de Hiring Manager (30 minuten, online) Assessmentgesprek (1 uur, op kantoor) Eindgesprek (30 minuten, online) Bij DataSnipper geloven we dat goede ideeën voortkomen uit verschillende perspectieven, ervaringen en achtergronden. We streven naar een inclusieve werkplek en bieden elke kandidaat een eerlijke en gelijkwaardige sollicitatie-ervaring. We selecteren op basis van competenties en prestaties, waarbij we kijken naar de vaardigheden, ervaring, het potentieel en de capaciteiten die relevant zijn voor de rol. We verwelkomen sollicitanten ongeacht leeftijd, ras, etniciteit, nationaliteit, gender, genderidentiteit of genderexpressie, seksuele oriëntatie, religie, beperking of elk ander kenmerk dat jou maakt wie je bent. Wat voor ons telt, is wat jij kunt toevoegen aan de rol, het team en DataSnipper. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

title: Werkstudent Financial Analytics
description: Onze missie Wij vertalen data naar betere zorg. Met onze inzichten maken we de gezondheidszorg betaalbaarder en verbeteren we de ervaring van patiënten en artsen. Jouw impact en verantwoordelijkheden LOGEX ontvangt elke maand data vanuit ziekenhuizen. Wij hebben een grotendeels geautomatiseerd proces om op basis van de data van het ziekenhuis periodieke analyses uit te voeren en de resultaten op te leveren aan de klant. Na de oplevering kunnen de ziekenhuizen via ons online platform op een interactief dashboard de resultaten inzien. Naast het interactieve dashboard leveren we ook detail informatie op richting deze ziekenhuizen.   Elke oplevering kent echter ook maatwerk: Is de data correct ingeladen? Zijn de uitkomsten betrouwbaar? Zijn alle onderdelen van het interactieve dashboard goed gevuld? Sluiten de cijfers tussen de detailinformatie in het interactieve dashboard op elkaar aan? Welke aandachtspunten moeten we communiceren richting het ziekenhuis?   Jouw rol is om het gehele proces te bewaken van de data aanlevering tot de uitkomsten in het interactieve dashboard. Jij zorgt er samen met collega’s voor dat alle ziekenhuizen periodiek inzicht hebben in hun financiële resultaten.  Het team Het Financial Analytics-team – momenteel ~40 mensen – groeit snel en is in volle gang. Het team is primair verantwoordelijk voor het faciliteren van financiële planning en controle van ziekenhuizen door hen met tools te ondersteunen bij o.a. duurzame portfoliobeslissingen, operationele processen en financiële overeenkomsten. Mede gedreven door de demografische ontwikkeling is er (reeds langere tijd) een sterke stijging van de zorgkosten. Om deze stijgende kosten onder controle te houden, is het essentieel om strategische portfoliobeslissingen te nemen, efficiënte zorg te bieden en duurzame financiële controle te behouden. De tools van het Financial Analytics team bieden hiervoor oplossingen. Jouw profiel Kan jij de onderstaande vragen met “ja” beantwoorden, dan is deze functie zeker wat voor jou! Doe jij een technische HBO of universitaire bachelor? Ben jij voor minimaal 9 maanden, 2 dagen per week beschikbaar? Haal jij energie uit het perfectioneren en blijven optimaliseren van doorlopende processen? Kan jij je goed vastbijten in een technische uitdaging tot jij de oplossing gevonden hebt? Vind je het gaaf om de verantwoordelijkheid te dragen voor de financiële inzichten, voorspellingen en doelmatigheidsdoorlichtingen van een groot aantal ziekenhuizen? Maak jij graag deel uit van een jong en enthousiast team? Ben je resultaatgericht, met een gestructureerde manier van werken en een pragmatische mentaliteit? Schrijf en spreek je vloeiend Nederlands en Engels? Waarom LOGEX? Een uitstekend beloningspakket (salaris, vakantiegeld, NS Business card, telefoon- en internetvergoeding) 25 vakantiedagen (op fulltime basis) om nieuwe energie op te doen, met de mogelijkheid om extra vakantiedagen te kopen Een informele werkomgeving met gedreven collega’s De mogelijkheid tot hybride werken Een laptop en alles wat je nodig hebt om thuis een comfortabele en ergonomische werkplek in te richten Persoonlijke en professionele ontwikkeling via onze LOGEX Academy Toegang tot onze partner op het gebied van mentale gezondheid; OpenUp Regelmatig borrels na het werk en nog veel meer evenementen Contact ons! We're looking for an AI Engineer to help build the next generation of AI-powered enterprise solutions.

As part of the Agent Factory team, you'll develop agents that can securely access enterprise systems, interact with business tools, manage context and memory effectively, and operate reliably at scale. Beyond technical delivery, you'll bring product thinking and commercial awareness, helping to identify meaningful customer challenges, emerging AI opportunities, and relevant market trends. Your insights will contribute to shaping and refining the Agent Factory roadmap and backlog.

This role is ideal for someone who enjoys building practical AI applications and can take solutions from concept through to production deployment.

What You'll Be Doing

Build and Deliver Intelligent Agents

  • Design, build and deploy AI agents that solve real customer and business problems.

  • Create agents that deliver value independently while contributing insights to a broader intelligence ecosystem.

  • Translate product requirements and use cases into scalable, production-ready solutions.

  • Build and operate Model Context Protocol (MCP) servers that provide agents with secure access to tools, systems and enterprise data.

Integrate Enterprise Systems

    • ServiceNow

    • Contact Centre and Customer Experience platforms

    • Internal and third-party APIs

Design Context, Memory & Intelligence

  • Define how agents manage memory, context and decision-making patterns.

  • Implement retrieval, reasoning and tool-use strategies that promote consistent and predictable behaviour.

  • Design guardrails that enable agents to operate safely and effectively within enterprise environments.

  • Develop supporting services including adapters, event processing capabilities and integration layers.

  • Enable agents to share insights and consume intelligence from a wider ecosystem of interconnected solutions.

  • Help shape future product direction by contributing technical expertise, customer insights and market observations.

  • Strong software engineering experience using C# and .NET.

  • Hands-on experience with Azure services, including:

    • Azure App Service

    • Azure OpenAI Service

    • Azure AI Foundry / AI Studio

  • Experience integrating with Microsoft business platforms such as:

    • Dynamics 365

    • Dataverse

    • Microsoft Graph

    • Power Platform

  • Knowledge of Azure security and identity services, including:

    • Microsoft Entra ID

    • Managed Identities

    • Azure Key Vault

Agentic AI & MCP Experience

    • Semantic Kernel

  • Experience with:

    • Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG)

  • Strong API integration experience, including REST APIs, webhooks and event-driven architectures.

  • Experience with cloud-native deployment, CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure-as-code approaches.

  • Understanding of performance, latency, reliability and cost considerations when working with Large Language Models in production.

  • Commitment to software quality, testing and continuous improvement.

  • Ability to work closely with QA teams on agent evaluation, testing and quality assurance.

Who You Are

You'll be successful in this role if you are:

  • A pragmatic builder who can take ideas from concept to production.

  • Passionate about applying AI to solve real-world business challenges.

  • Comfortable working independently while collaborating with cross-functional teams.

  • A systems thinker who understands how individual components contribute to larger platforms and architectures.

  • Security-conscious and focused on building reliable enterprise-grade solutions.

  • Excited by emerging AI technologies and eager to learn as the landscape evolves.

Nice to Have

While not essential, we'd be particularly interested in candidates with experience in:

  • Multi-agent architectures and agent-to-agent communication.

  • Delivering AI solutions within enterprise or regulated environments.

  • LLM observability, monitoring, tracing, and evaluation frameworks.

  • Contact Centre, Customer Experience, or enterprise workflow automation platforms.

Why Join Us?

This is an opportunity to help shape the future of AI within a rapidly evolving product organisation. You'll work with cutting-edge Microsoft AI technologies, contribute directly to innovative agentic solutions, and play a key role in building scalable AI capabilities that deliver measurable value to customers. If you're passionate about building intelligent systems and want to be at the forefront of enterprise AI innovation, we'd love to hear from you.

Information Security Responsibilities

At AnywhereNow, information security is everyone's responsibility. All employees are expected to actively support and maintain the organisation's information security standards and contribute to protecting the confidentiality, integrity and availability of company and customer information.

This includes:

  • Adhering to all applicable information security policies, procedures and guidelines at all times.

  • Protecting company, customer and partner data from unauthorised access, disclosure, alteration or loss.

  • Using company systems, devices and networks in a secure and compliant manner.

  • Promptly reporting any suspected or actual security incidents, breaches or vulnerabilities to the appropriate team.

  • Completing mandatory information security and data protection training as required.

  • Ensuring that confidential information is handled and stored securely in accordance with company policies and applicable legal requirements.

Failure to comply with information security responsibilities may result in disciplinary action.

title: Accounts Receivable Specialist
description: Over Jumbo Group: De wereld van Jumbo Group is gevuld met spelletjes, puzzels en speelgoed die vreugde verspreiden en creativiteit over de hele wereld stimuleren. Met bekende merken zoals Stratego, Party & Co, Jan van Haasteren-puzzels en natuurlijk het fantastische merk Hitster, geven ze de ‘Kracht om te Spelen’ vrij om overal betekenisvolle verbindingen te creëren. De kernwaarden van het bedrijf zijn betrokkenheid, teamwork, wereldwijd denken en vertrouwen. De bedrijfscultuur is informeel, open en nuchter. Functieomschrijving Als Accounts Receivable Specialist speel je een belangrijke rol binnen de financiële organisatie en ben je verantwoordelijk voor het optimaal beheren van de debiteurenportefeuille. Je draagt bij aan een gezonde cashflow door betalingsprocessen effectief te bewaken, kredietrisico’s te beheersen en tijdig actie te ondernemen waar nodig. Je werkt nauw samen met verschillende interne afdelingen, waaronder Sales en Customer Service, en fungeert als een belangrijke schakel tussen financiële en operationele processen. Met jouw analytische vaardigheden, nauwkeurige werkwijze en proactieve houding draag je bij aan het verder optimaliseren van het order-to-cash proces en ondersteun je de organisatie bij het realiseren van haar financiële doelstellingen. Taken en verantwoordelijkheden: Verwerken van dagelijkse bankmutaties Onderzoeken en opvolgen van factuurafwijkingen en openstaande posten. Schakelen met Sales en Customer Service om geblokkeerde orders (orders in wacht) snel op te lossen. Opstellen en analyseren van ouderdomsanalyses (AR Aging Reports) om betaaltrends en risico's vroegtijdig te signaleren. Vaststellen, bewaken en onderhouden van kredietlimieten en financiële afspraken voor nieuwe en bestaande klanten. Aanmaken en onderhouden van klantstamgegevens in het ERP-systeem. Aandragen van procesverbeteringen en deelnemen aan financiële en IT-gerelateerde projecten. Functie eisen: MBO+ werk- en denkniveau en een afgeronde opleiding in financieel-administratieve richting. Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in een soortgelijke rol binnen debiteurenbeheer. Ervaring met ERP-systemen is een must. Uitstekende kennis van Excel voor het maken van analyses. Analytisch sterk en nauwkeurig in het signaleren van afwijkingen en kredietrisico's. Uitstekende beheersing van de Nederlandse en Engelse taal, zowel in woord als geschrift. Duits is een pre. Overig: Je bent een communicatieve teamspeler die stevig in zijn schoenen staat en overtuigingskracht heeft. Een informele, open werksfeer met korte communicatielijnen. title: Wir suchen einen niederländischsprachigen Personalvermittler!
description: Die Organisation: Kannst du dir vorstellen internatione/r Rekrutierer/in zu sein? Dann hast du das richtige Stellenangebot für dich gefunden! Zur Erweiterung unseres Teams, suchen wir eine/n begeisterte/n Kollegen/in. PhysioMatch vermittelt abenteuerlustige Physiotherapeuten und Physiotherapeutinnen aus ganz Europa, vor allem an Praxen in der Schweiz. PhysioMatch tut dies in Zusammenarbeit mit CareToMatch, das seinen Sitz in der Schweiz hat. Bewerber und Kunden stellen uns ihre Anforderungen zur Verfügung und wir kümmern uns um den Abgleich. Du begleitest den Physiotherapeuten dann persönlich durch den Auswanderungsprozess. Aufgaben Als Personalvermittler/in bei PhysioMatch konzentrieren sich du und deine Kollegen/innen auf die Schweiz. Du vermittelst arbeitssuchenden Physiotherapeuten an die Stelle, die am besten zu ihr/ihm passt. Natürlich müssen einige Dinge arrangiert werden, um in der Schweiz arbeiten zu können, wobei du den Kandidaten bei diesem Abenteuer mit maßgeschneiderten Informationen hilfst. raw.description:
About Vitestro

Founded in 2017 in Utrecht, Vitestro is pioneering the future of blood collection with the Aletta® Autonomous Robotic Phlebotomy Device™ (ARPD™). This groundbreaking medical device combines advanced multi-modal imaging (near-infrared, ultrasound, and Doppler ultrasound) with robotics and AI to perform the entire diagnostic blood draw procedure autonomously.

 

By addressing critical healthcare staffing shortages and improving patient experience, Vitestro is transforming one of the most common and essential medical procedures. With more than 130 team members and growing rapidly, we are scaling our impact. As we placed our first devices with customers, we are now expanding our team to ensure successful implementation and long-term reliability.

 

At Vitestro, we are committed to continuous innovation and improvement.

Master Data Engineer

As our Master Data Engineer, you own the accuracy and integrity of the master data behind every Aletta we build: items, bills of materials (BOMs), revisions and routings in our ERP system. You translate the engineering BOM released by R&D into the manufacturing BOM for products, sub-assemblies and spare parts. You also own the change control process between Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain, from the first change request to the verified change in the build. This is a newly created role in our Operations team.

First months at Vitestro

In your first months, your focus will be on two things. First, you set up the change process end to end: from an engineering change to its implementation in the build, including the impact on time and cost. You register changes, organize the impact assessment with Operations, Supply Chain and Quality, chair the change review board, and define effectivity and the disposition of existing stock. Second, you build the manufacturing BOMs for our products from the engineering BOMs. You structure sub-assemblies to match the assembly sequence, add consumables, packaging, labels, kitting and the make/buy split, and set up spare-part and service BOMs together with Service. Along the way, you define how system and module upgrades are managed through the BOM.

You become the single point of contact for master data and change implementation. You make sure every build uses the correct released configuration, so that each Device History Record traces back to the Device Master Record.

This is what success looks like:

After 12 months, engineering changes run through one controlled process, and every change is implemented, verified in the first build and closed in the change record. Product and spare-part BOMs are free of errors, and master data is audit-ready under ISO 13485. Engineering, Operations and Supply Chain know where a change stands and when it reaches the build. Regular comparisons between E-BOM, M-BOM and as-built show no open discrepancies.

You thrive at the intersection of engineering and operations. You are precise and process-minded, you keep the discipline when others are in a hurry, and you are comfortable holding a change that isn't ready yet.


What You’ll Bring:

  • A bachelor's or master's background in Mechanical, Mechatronics or Industrial Engineering, or a similar technical field

  • 3+ years in master data, BOM, configuration or engineering change management in a manufacturing environment, preferably MedTech or high-tech

  • Experience with an ERP system, such as Odoo, SAP or Exact

  • Solid understanding of E-BOM and M-BOM structures, item lifecycle and revision control

  • Strong ability to align cross-functional stakeholders and keep process discipline

  • Comfortable working with detail: analytical, accurate and process-minded

  • Excellent communication skills

  • Fluent in English

Nice to have:

  • Experience in a regulated environment (ISO 13485, DMR/DHR, design transfer)

  • Familiarity with a PLM system

  • Experience reading technical drawings, and basic 3D CAD knowledge

  • Experience with advanced Excel or data tooling for data validation

  • Dutch language skills

How We Work

At Vitestro, ownership is not a slogan - it is an expectation. We trust people to take responsibility, make decisions, and drive work forward.

We believe breakthroughs happen when talented people combine dedication, accountability, and teamwork. That means:

  • We take initiative rather than wait for direction.

  • We focus on execution and delivering results.

  • We proactively remove blockers and help each other succeed.

  • We challenge ideas, not people.

  • We continuously learn, improve, and raise the bar.

  • We celebrate team success over individual heroics.

We move fast, but we do so thoughtfully. We care deeply about quality because the technology we build ultimately impacts patients and healthcare professionals.

If you are looking for an environment where you can make a significant contribution, take ownership of meaningful work, and be surrounded by highly motivated colleagues, we'd love to meet you.

What we offer 

  • Competitive salary including pension plan 

  • 25 days of annual leave based on a full-time position 

  • Hybrid work model 

  • Working together in a high-skilled team with our home base in Utrecht 

  • Frequent out-of-work activities with our team, and annual company weekend away.

  • Training budget 

  • Opportunity to be key shaper of a new global industry niche: autonomous medical robotics 

We’re big fans of working from the office – this is where team spirit comes alive. At the same time, we offer flexibility, allowing up to two (out of 5) days of working from home for those who prefer it. 

Are you excited? 

We totally understand that and so are we! By joining us, you can play an active role in changing the future of health care. Excited to join our revolution? Then we’d love to hear from you! 

If you think you've got what it takes, but you don't meet all the requirements - we still recommend you apply. We would love to learn about your interest and experience and consider if you can be a good fit for Vitestro. Nobody is a perfect fit, and we welcome applications with imperfections. title: Stage Privacy & Data
description: Ben jij een student die energie krijgt van processen doorgronden en puzzels oplossen, met interesse in privacy en data? Wil je bijdragen aan een duurzamere wereld en zien hoe nieuwe wetgeving landt in een snel groeiend bedrijf? Dan is MyWheels op zoek naar jou! Over MyWheels MyWheels gelooft in een toekomst waarin je mobiliteit inricht op wat je écht nodig hebt, niet op wat je bezit. Toegang tot de juiste auto, op het juiste moment. Wij bouwen het platform dat dat mogelijk maakt. Als grootste elektrische mobiliteitsplatform van Nederland gaan we verder dan toegang tot een auto. Via Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) leveren onze elektrische auto’s ook stroom terug aan het energienet. Zo pakken we tegelijk de netcongestie aan en bouwen we aan de energie- én mobiliteitsvoorziening van de toekomst. ⚡ Vanuit ons kantoor in Amsterdam werkt een enthousiast team van zo’n 50 mensen aan dit platform. Samen bouwen we aan iets wat echt telt. Wat ga je doen? Als stagiair Privacy & Data ondersteun je ons bij het verder brengen van ons privacy-programma in de breedste zin van het woord. Je werkt mee aan onze processen en verwerkingen, en verdiept je in de Leidraad Data Delen van de ACM, die praktische richtlijnen geeft over hoe de Europese Data Act door Nederlandse bedrijven moet worden uitgevoerd. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Security Lead, die je begeleidt, en kunt steunen op zijn contacten met onze Functionaris Gegevensbescherming en de Legal Counsel van onze moedermaatschappij. Je werkt nauw samen met onze Security Lead, jouw begeleider. Jouw verantwoordelijkheden Je houdt ons register van verwerkingen actueel en brengt onze processen en verwerkingen visueel in kaart, in gesprek met collega’s uit alle teams; Je verdiept je in de Leidraad Data Delen en helpt uitzoeken wat dat betekent voor MyWheels en onze deelauto’s; Je duikt in klantklachten over privacy en ontrafelt de lastige gevallen: wat is er gebeurd, en hoe lossen we het op?; Signaleren van quick wins en verbeterkansen op het gebied van privacy en data. Verbondenheid met de duurzame impact doelstellingen van MyWheels; Je hebt interesse in de praktische kant van wet-en regelgeving en dan voornamelijk op het gebied van privacy en data; Je volgt een juridische opleiding, bij voorkeur WO Rechtsgeleerdheid of HBO Rechten, maar iedere student met de juiste interesse is welkom; Je zoekt een meewerkstage om praktijkervaring op te doen; Je bent zelfstandig, proactief en leergierig en durft kritische vragen te stellen; Je beheerst de Nederlandse en Engelse taal goed, zowel mondeling als schriftelijk; Het is een pré als je al iets weet van de AVG of de Data Act. The good stuff 👇 Een stage met een duurzame missie; Een stagevergoeding van € 400 bruto per maand o.b.v. 40-urige werkweek, passend bij je werkervaring; Een open werksfeer en borrels; Ruimte voor ideeën en initiatieven; Flexibiliteit en hybride werken; Een laptop in bruikleen. Jouw werktijden Je loopt 32 tot 40 uur per week stage binnen een hybride werkstructuur. Onze werktijden zijn van 09:00 tot 17:30, waarbij je minimaal twee dagen per week op ons kantoor in Amsterdam bent. Waar kom je te werken? Ons kantoor is vlak bij treinstation Amsterdam Bijlmer Arena. Daar werk je samen met een enthousiast team van ongeveer 50 collega’s met specialisaties in onder andere sales, operations, development en finance. Iedereen draagt vanuit zijn of haar expertise bij aan één gezamenlijk doel: de groei van MyWheels en het bouwen aan slimmere mobiliteit. Sollicitatieproces: Wij reageren op jouw sollicitatie binnen 14 dagen; Kennismakingsgesprek met Jamal (Security Lead) Welkom aan boord! Interesse? Wil je meehelpen om impact te maken? Stuur dan je sollicitatie inclusief cv en motivatie naar ons toe. We nemen dan zo snel mogelijk contact met je op. Find more English Speaking Jobs in Netherlands on Arbeitnow

Our Graduate Quantitative Researcher (2027 Start) role is currently open.<a href="https://www.optiver.com/join-us/jobs/quantitative-research-and-machine-learning/amsterdam/graduate-quantitative-researcher-2027-start/?gh_jid=8585609002"> Apply here.</a></p> <p>If you enjoy using mathematics and code to investigate difficult questions, you could make a direct contribution to Optiver’s success in global markets. As a Graduate Quantitative Researcher, you’ll work across the full research process, from framing the question and choosing the data to building, testing and deploying models. Machine Learning is central to the work, whether you’re extracting signals, forecasting prices or modelling relationships. Our data, compute and production infrastructure let you test ideas quickly, understand where they fail and decide what to investigate next.</p> <p>Our researchers believe in academic discourse and invite fellow researchers, traders and engineers to challenge each hypothesis. Different perspectives help improve the question, the model and how it performs in production. Through constant testing, analysis and refinement, you’ll help our quantitative models adapt as markets evolve.</p> <p><strong>WHAT YOU’LL DO</strong></p> <p><strong>Your onboarding&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>You’ll&nbsp;participate&nbsp;in&nbsp;<a href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ONPObMHh-k8">Global Optiver Academy</a>, a structured&nbsp;onboarding programme for graduates. It gives new joiners a shared foundation in how Optiver trades, builds systems, and manages risk before they move into their teams.&nbsp;As part of your onboarding,&nbsp;you'll&nbsp;gain exposure to the AI tools and technologies that support research and development across the business.&nbsp;</p> <p><strong>Your responsibilities&nbsp;</strong></p> <p>Depending on the team you join, you'll own the research end to end. That could include:</p> <ul> <li>Building models for pricing, forecasting and signal discovery, choosing the statistical, mathematical or Machine Learning methods that best fit the problem.</li> <li>Working across petabytes of market, order-flow and unstructured data to find signals that improve strategies as conditions change.</li> <li>Monitoring models in production and using live behavior to refine your assumptions and decide what to investigate next.</li> <li>Using deep learning and AI-enabled workflows to shorten the loop from hypothesis to evidence.</li> <li>Working directly with researchers, traders and engineers to shape problems and understand how system constraints affect performance.</li> </ul> <p><strong>WHO YOU ARE</strong></p> <p>We're looking for aspiring Quantitative Researchers who are versatile and creative in innovating and suggesting new solutions. title: Quantitative Researcher - 2027 Graduates
description: <p>At Graviton, we don't believe the best trading strategies come from following established playbooks. They come from asking better questions. Why does a pattern exist? What is driving it? Is it real or just noise? Can it be explained, modelled and turned into an edge?</p> <p>As a Quantitative Researcher, you'll work on those questions every day. You'll investigate market behaviour, develop quantitative models, build and test hypotheses and turn insights into trading strategies, working alongside researchers and technologists in an environment where an idea on a whiteboard can reach live trading quickly.</p> <p>This isn't a role where the answers are in a textbook. The problems are open-ended, the data is enormous, and finding the answers is the job.</p> <p>Ideal candidates are rigorous thinkers who genuinely enjoy mathematics, programming and figuring out things that aren't obvious, based in our Singapore, London, Amsterdam or US offices.</p> <h2>What You'll Work On</h2> <p>You'll work across quantitative research and systematic trading, taking ideas through the full lifecycle: question, hypothesis, experiment, model, validation, strategy, production. Depending on your team and research interests, your work would include:</p> <ul> <li>Discovering predictive patterns and sources of alpha from billions of market events</li> <li>Formulating hypotheses about market behaviour and designing experiments to test them</li> <li>Applying probability, statistics, optimization and machine learning to build predictive models and quantitative signals for systematic trading</li> <li>Designing robust backtests and statistical tests to distinguish genuine signals from noise</li> <li>Working with large and complex datasets to uncover patterns that aren't immediately visible</li> <li>Investigating market microstructure and how markets behave at different timescales</li> <li>Evaluating strategy performance, identifying weaknesses and continuously refining models</li> <li>Developing research infrastructure and AI-powered tools and agents that make experimentation faster and analysis deeper</li> <li>Working closely with technologists to translate research ideas into efficient, production-ready systems</li> <li>Exploring new techniques in machine learning, statistics and quantitative finance to uncover new sources of edge</li> </ul> <p>No two research problems are the same. Good research finds patterns. raw.title: Sentinel System Engineer - Post Launch Support
raw.description:
We are looking for a Sentinel System Engineer on behalf of the European Space Agency (ESA) for their location in Noordwijk, the Netherlands. 

 

Please note, the successful candidate will be employed by ATG Europe (or one of its subsidiaries). Furthermore, upon selection, they will be subject to a general security screening performed by an external provider (further information will be provided at the interview stage). 

 

ATG is dedicated to diversity and inclusion and is an equal opportunity employer. Regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, or any other reason protected by relevant state or municipal legislation, we are pleased to consider all eligible candidates for employment. 

 

The successful candidate will be tasked with, but not limited to: 

 

  • Coordinate the internal & external support to PLS (ESA Space Segment Development Team, TEC experts, Mission Analysis & System Support, Industry);  

  • Coordinate with the ESA Space Segment Development Team (where relevant) to exchange technical status on the flying- and non-flying satellite(s), identifying coordination issues of relevance and following them to conclusion;  

  • Support PLS at the regular (weekly) Operations Boards; 

  • Support the Operations Team(s) by providing or facilitating responses to technical support requests from either the Flight Operations Segment (FOS) or Payload Data Ground Segment (PDGS);  

  • Maintain & distribute the PLS On-Call lists to the FOS (& other parties where relevant) in a timely manner; 

  • Support the Mission Manager and his/her team by providing technical advice related to issues of Satellite(s) performance; 

  • Support the Space Segment Development Team(s) by providing timely & pertinent feedback on any issue detected in-flight with potential impact on satellite(s) still under development;  

  • Provide specific technical expertise to support Performance Monitoring, Analysis & Optimisation tasks and Anomaly Investigations, with overall aim to improve mission quality and/or lifetime; 

  • Preparation of Technical Documentation, such as Reports, Technical Notes and other requested documentation; 

  • Review and synthesis of Technical Reports and documents produced by Industry, and extraction of relevant technical information for use in generation of PLS Performance metrics and reports; 

  • Organise and support the 6-monthly Satellite In-Orbit Performance (SIOP) Technical Meetings in cooperation with the Industrial Prime contractor, including associated follow-up activities (eg. administration, actions follow up etc); 

  • Respond to Anomaly Warnings received from the Flight Operations Segment (FOS) in an appropriate & timely manner, providing support and facilitating the necessary follow-on actions;  

  • Support and lead complex investigations that arise as a result of satellite performance and anomalies, ensuring adequate coordination with involved partners (Mission Management, Operations Team(s), Industry, Space Segment Development Team(s), Management);   

  • Prepare, coordinate & follow-up on engineering requests for the Industrial contractors in support of Anomaly Investigations and other technical analyses;   

  • Support satellite configuration control including the Configuration Control Board (CCB);   

  • Support Satellite Decommissioning & Disposal activities as required;   

  • Monitor, track and report the status of activities performed by the Industrial contractors in support of the PLS function (technical, commercial and schedule status);  

  • Review commercial payment requests & the associated justifications submitted by Industry (regular milestones or as result of ad-hoc Cost Reimbursement activities);   

  • Bring innovation to satellite performance analysis by investigating emerging technologies that enhance the ability for early detection of performance trends and deviations;   

  • Maintain the relevant PLS technical records, databases & documentation in accordance with established procedures;   

  • Maintain a regular reporting in coordination with the Technical Officer. 


Please ensure that your CV clearly explains how you meet the mandatory requirements. If it doesn’t align completely with the essential criteria, it could result in rejection. 

Requirements  

  • University degree in a relevant Engineering discipline;   

  • Minimum 10 years of experience and a significant background in one or more of the following domains: Satellite Operations, Spacecraft Development (including Project Engineering, Equipment/Subsystem Procurement, Assembly Integration & Test);   

  • Minimum 3 years’ experience working as a System Engineer or with a System Coordination function in any of the above domains;   

  • Good understanding of the Satellite Phase E2 Routine Operations Organisation and the typical activities performed;   

  • Good understanding of the factors affecting the short- and long-term performance of Satellites and their main subsystems or payloads;   

  • Experience managing and leading technical meetings and discussions with multiple stakeholders;

  • Proven experience & ability at working in an environment with multiple external interfaces;   

  • Good at working in a team and a proactive attitude to solving problems  

  • Autonomy in writing technical notes, specifications and reports in English;   

  • Good interpersonal skills and team spirit;   

  • Demonstrable multidisciplinary or system-level experience in the satellite engineering domain;  

  • Previous working experience in a multinational environment is desirable;  

  • Very good knowledge of MS Office tools; 

  • Fluency in English, both written and spoken; 

  • Candidates must be eligible to work in the EU. 

 

Please submit your application in English via the apply button below. Applications submitted in other languages will not be considered.
